name: Jake Duesenberg
subject: This is an Important Date
body:
August 9th

| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_email_1&n=1)
---
## Why You Should Vote on August 9th
Friend, There's an important election coming up on **Tuesday, August 9th**. This is YOUR chance to determine who is the best candidate to support for the November election. You likely know that A LOT of grassroots, conservative candidates have stepped up to run this year. But the Republican Establishment does not want them to succeed. In most races, they recruited challengers who are either sitting legislators or tied to the Political Class to run against these freedom champions. As we reported a couple weeks ago, even the [MNGOP Chair tried sabotaging the campaigns](https://www.action4liberty.com/hann_harms_endorsed_candidates?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_email_1&n=2) of some of these candidates by cutting off their data access. The Establishment's goal is to fool enough primary voters into believing that their candidate is the "conservative" - when in reality, they just want the person who will go to the Capitol and do what they're told by the Party bosses. **This is everything you and I stand against. But YOU have the ability to ruin the Establishment's plans!!!** **** On August 9th, you can go to your local polling place and vote in the Primary for the best candidate who represents your values. If this is your first time, here's a checklist for you:
* Find your polling location. Click on this link: [**FIND POLLING PLACE**](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=ubk1FolAq6WRuAxNmhA93VJcs5l4BDTnm18Mfb6IJCl64TykgpW9Go6kyZmIAH4s&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_email_1&n=3)
* Look up your sample ballot and make sure to only vote for candidates in one party. The Primary election works a little different than the general election where you can vote for anyone. In the primary, once you vote for a person of one party, you can only vote for the candidates of that party. A sample ballot is found at the same link as above.
* Learn how sitting legislators vote in St Paul. Did you know that all Senators have a failing grade on our scorecard? And in the Minnesota House, there's only a few who have scored an "A" grade. Visit [**MNSCORECARD.COM**](https://www.action4liberty.com/scorecard?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_email_1&n=4)**** to learn more.

## **Jake Duesenberg**
**Action 4 Liberty** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_to_reach_more?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_email_1&n=5 "Support Us") [Support Us](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate_to_reach_more?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_email_1&n=5)

Fellow American,

For the first time in Georgia's history, both Democrats and Republicans have nominated a Black man for the U.S. Senate.

This is indeed historic and speaks to the greatness of America's experiment with democracy. Less than 70 years ago, people like Senator Raphael Warnock and me were not able to attend the same schools as white children.

Now, we're running against one another - two Black men - in what is shaping up to be the most competitive Senate race of the entire 2022 midterm elections. Fox News has even gone so far as to say, _**"The U.S. Senate race in Georgia is key for determining control of the upper house next year."**_

**That may be where the similarities end.**

If you've read recent emails from my campaign, you'll recall that a far-Left columnist - and a regular guest on MSNBC - has trained his fire on me. Since April, he has lobbed multiple racial epithets against me that are offensive to me personally and to the entire Black community.

In the past, he said:

| _**"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."**_
---

and
_**"I make a hard distinction between black conservatives and these tokens (I.E. HERSCHEL WALKER AND TIM SCOTT), who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**_
---

This week, he went on MSNBC and lobbed his most disgusting attack yet: _**"Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their Negroes: to do what they're told."**_
---

**Shame on him for saying it, and shame on MSNBC for airing it.**

Despite these racially based insults making national news, Senator Warnock has said nothing.

Hello,
Thirty-six years in the Navy gave me a ton of memories. Most are good; some are complex; others are conflicted...
It was early 2005, a stressful time. There were no days off or dinners with family, and I was with the Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, a four-star General.
That night, our meeting at the White House was unexpectedly canceled. There was still a bit of daylight outside, and the General turned to me and said, “How ‘bout that, Franken. We have the evening off...”
I took a quick look at my watch, and it hit me: “I may get out of here in time to see my son play in the orchestra.”
I hadn’t even realized I’d said it aloud until the Vice Chief asked, “Oh, what instrument does he play?”
I’ve always thought of myself as a person with answers. I did my homework, worked hard, and put in the effort to be prepared. But I didn’t know the answer to this simple question about being a father, a doting parent, and one of my children.
I felt guilty, embarrassed, and uttered a weak, “I am not entirely sure,” past the lump in my throat.
I have long-since gotten used to people thanking me for my service – whether it was traveling through an airport in uniform or wearing my Navy hat in the grocery store. **But I always thank service members’ families. Their spouse. Their parents. Their children.**
It was my family who had to ‘get along’ without me. My parents aged during my long absences, then both died before I could tell them thank you. Too many long distance moves were done by Jordan, my wife, alone. And too many school events passed without me even knowing they were happening. My family sacrificed as much as I did for me to be able to serve.
I’m now running for Senate because I know what it means to live a life of service and sacrifice. Too many in Washington have long since forgotten who they work for. I know my opponent Chuck Grassley is one of those people. He’s still clinging to Senate office after more than four decades because he knows nothing else.
My question to Chuck Grassley is this: “Are you running again because that’s what Iowans want or that’s what your big corporate donors demand of you?” If you ask Iowans, they all say it is the latter.
Every poll shows we can win, and the GOP mob is already circling in response. But with your help now, I know we can defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Senate majority.
**We need to raise another $35,000 before our deadline at midnight tonight to fight back against all of Mitch McConnell’s Super PAC lies and win, but right now, it looks like we are about to fall short. I need your help now to fend them off and retire Grassley because control of the Senate is at stake.**
[**If you believe as I do that there are still good people running for office, then please, will you chip in $5 or more right now – every dollar you can afford – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48755646/359480641/-42398318?refcode=em20220804am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NzkyOTYwMS1lZDEzLWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8b3TwmDh60noKYTQ06gMjbZc6SpAfJNszdbvNKYle3U=)

A conservative panel of judges on the New Orleans federal appeals court is considering arguments about the legality of DACA – and if they decide to rule against the program, the lives of _**over 611,000 Dreamers**_ could be severely altered.

New York alone is home to tens of thousands of DACA recipients – and a future without them is simply unfathomable. DACA recipients are vital to our economy, to our communities, and to our way of life.

A conservative panel of judges on the New Orleans federal appeals court is considering arguments about the legality of DACA – and if they decide to rule against the program, the lives of over 611,000 Dreamers could be severely altered. New York alone is home to tens of thousands of DACA recipients – and a future without them is simply unfathomable. DACA recipients are vital to our economy, to our communities, and to our way of life. In 2021, I led a coalition of 23 attorneys general across the nation to file an amicus brief in support of DACA, but our fight is far from over. Peter, I’m counting on activists like you to join the fight for immigrants' rights, so please: Will you take a moment now to answer this quick poll? | | Should Dreamers be protected? | | | | Thanks for fighting with me. | | Friend,

| I left two legs in the deserts of Afghanistan, but what Joe Biden left there one year ago this month was far worse.

In his disastrous withdrawal - which his Administration spent almost zero time planning because they were apparently too busy _teaching soldiers Critical Race Theory_ \- it was the _dead bodies_ of our allies that were left behind.

Whether it was the 13 service members killed by terrorists who Biden let waltz out of jail...

Or the American citizens left behind enemy lines...

Or the allies who risked their lives to help us on the battlefield now facing a death sentence from the Taliban...

**Every single tragedy there rests on one man’s shoulders:_Joe Biden left them all dead and abandoned._**

That’s why - as someone who served and sacrificed there - I am making it a personal mission to get accountability for these Afghanistan failures, and I need a team of dedicated Americans like you to help take back the House ASAP.

You see, Democrats aren’t doing anything to get accountability for these crimes. In fact, Pelosi’s crew is even helping shred evidence about the Afghanistan disaster. So, our one chance to get accountability for what might be the greatest embarrassment to our military in American history is this November.

_If we blow it, we will never have another opportunity to hold Biden accountable._

**_[With that being said, I’m respectfully asking for any reinforcements you can spare to help Republicans retake the majority. This time of year in the past has been a bit of a “summer slump” for us in terms of fundraising, but with the August 23rd Election in just a few weeks, we can’t afford that right now. We need all hands on deck.](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=701950baaaa847c195b37fe23d82949e&_e=_OHyPktGh8Z8qknDHh_8mLifvGUO-IC_F9OPfYFVf-J_ta43dsiJzSvokjW6l95h_s2W5gaUHRvBatzc9OjhcLRW1almOl1CSvKiIPqQLMixV205VSFpnOHH3RcCeB2RCrEK1MrKAZM_iVd07w6eC7-aM9RK1bBNvH5Ye2DcPR1ceip7dBbtMO0uAjLn3Vq1WpDy8vu9cFkEN0Ke-ybwSUoLuclcHtKr8ACZIadH62eKea5tavFtSrddfcCWDpBpyRBdQvUAQYzXgnBIv43B77jbQOm_s1DImXYWYt1f7Pyxj5UqeYCnrBcDC-T6Q_2fHoYovXQi6b4-aijwKOdehlBbt3Bl6dlffZ2_eTzAB8zvybWm0VTBIXY1PkH3_t4T)_****__**

**Please, can I personally count on you to help me with my mission to hold Biden’s feet to the fire for this Afghanistan failure? →**

name: Conservative Liberty Wire
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e7a35a2478cc4def854c936ee18b5b5e&_e=sAiDRVlMRIJDqIiy21ls5xGg4vkyRl-HkUtUyjSZ4A5bdzFrKhE63RmgTzYbX6dps3jVEzDlHainH6prgyMQw6aAsnER6wmJuzZWPsPDAjQjhwfJOET7YW4VM1F4Krs8-QkMUISGY3DuU9fhJs51_lxwgRnKNGcMLWKxzKPoEiJc-zjkJa6v5fvhkUgHFa4y9sICyvmAibzJT8kvrQWqqtq4LxE8vg7nZExfOsRJVJ_XbQPrPxdCIl950LOyd2bXpnYez-wXE4LuveRw67mhR6Nwkw9JQmdstrOpFIiISnNf420hPz5VgBapaIgeEcK-WqU71CeB1tCdCgzTxevuBXm-Lw3VJ3ukQeeiuPmMk1_isrhuiDJofoOr4RlF5xfHVGbxesPOPKIzfBvDG50-3GfnEZ_Bb-vnGcWl22rXchA40Vd7OkyuGPnH91-y9157Mu_UcUx0a-KqgHMdeF-lqA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Peter,

When I was elected Governor in 2018, I knew I was up for a challenge. I knew we would lead the nation with a bold agenda, but I had no idea the forces we’d be up against.

I had been fighting against the Obama administration’s rejection of the founding principles of our country. The Biden administration is even worse.

Over the last three and a half years, I have fought for Floridians on every front and secured Florida’s standing as America’s beachhead of freedom.

We have continued to fight for Floridians each and every day. We stood up against the corporate media, against bureaucrats like Fauci, and against Brandon himself.

To keep the state of Florida open, to protect people’s jobs, and to save businesses, we rejected mandates for COVID jabs. We made it ILLEGAL in the state of Florida to force a student in our school system to get a COVID shot they don’t want.

When Brandon and his lackeys tried to attack our employees and corporations, we called a special session of the legislature to pass protections for individuals.

No Floridian should have to choose between a job they need and a jab they don’t want.

We banned vaccine passports in the state of Florida because we believe you should be able to participate in society without being marginalized based on your personal medical decision to get a jab or not.

Through it all, we refused to bow down to Fauci and his ridiculous authoritarian decrees.

These are just a few of the ways Florida has led and stood up against the restrictive mandates being forced on the country. If it were not for Florida, the lockdown mob would have won.

Instead, we have stood strong, and we have stood for freedom. Our state is better for it, and our country is better off for what we did.

Ron DeSantis

I'm Tudor Dixon. I'm a businesswoman, a breast-cancer survivor, and a working mom of four girls who's running for Governor of Michigan to FIRE radical liberal Gretchen Whitmer.

I'd like you to watch my victory speech so you can see what my campaign is all about.

[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60935949:JxSeu6VZN:m:1:3317145305:485F266AB8EC2672254DBDEDDE9AD4D2:r)
---
You see, Michigan is the birthplace of American ingenuity. We are the workers and the dreamers and the doers. But things have changed in our state, and not for the better.
---
Gretchen Whitmer and her far-Left policies have devastated Michigan over the last four years, and especially during her unscientific, tyrannical lockdowns in 2020.
---
An entire generation of students was set up for failure when Whitmer locked the doors to every school in our state.
---
People have lost their jobs, businesses, and life savings.
---
I've visited with the restaurant owners, the barbers, the florists, and the long list of small businesses and workers who were denied the ability to make a living because Whitmer thought she knew better.
---
I've talked with the men and women who lost their jobs, or closed their businesses, because they just couldn't make it work with the "closed by Whitmer" sign on the front door.
---
**The Queen of Lockdowns decided that YOU were not essential - and then she turned around and broke her own rules when it suited her. **
---
I lost my grandmother in a nursing home during Whitmer's lockdown, and I wasn't even allowed into the room to say goodbye. My daughters and I were forced to peek through a window.
---
These policies were cruel, and they did NOTHING to protect public health and safety.
---
It's been a long four years, but this November, we _finally_ have a chance to hold her accountable. We can _finally_ bring America First leadership to Michigan and get our state back on track.
---

**[_CONTRIBUTE TO FIRE WHITMER >>_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60935948:JxSeu6VZN:m:1:3317145305:485F266AB8EC2672254DBDEDDE9AD4D2:r)**
---

Whitmer is cheering every disastrous Biden policy that has plunged us into a recession.
---
She's driven the price of groceries through the roof. And that's just for the groceries you can actually find on the shelf! Baby formula? Who needs it, right?
---
Families are struggling just to put food on the table. But the truth is, Whitmer doesn't care!
---
Her policy proposals include shutting down pipelines, and she tried to RAISE the gas tax. She's an eager participant in Biden's insane war on our domestic energy industry.
---
_This comes at a time when the average gas price in Michigan is well over $4 a gallon!_
---
When Whitmer finally reopened our schools, she poisoned our children's minds with crazy left-wing anti-American ideas like critical race theory and radical gender theory.
---
She doesn't want parents to have any say in their children's education!
---
Whitmer has embraced the "spirit" of the defund-the-police movement, even as violent crime in Michigan increases at DOUBLE the rate of the national average.
---
She's happily put the safety of our communities in jeopardy to appease her far-Left base!
---
With a track record like that, you'd think her defeat would be assured in November...
---
_... but national Democrats are desperate to keep control of this key swing state. _
---
_They know it could decide the 2024 elections, so they want to make sure they have a far-Left puppet who can put her finger on the scales to hurt President Trump and swing the election towards Democrats._
---
That's why they've poured millions of dollars into Michigan to prop up Whitmer. She's currently sitting on a war chest of over $14.7 MILLION, and she's going to spend every penny of it to try to torpedo our surging campaign.
---
We need to be prepared for an onslaught of lying attack ads, and we need to secure the funds to FIGHT BACK. That's where you come in, Peter.
---

**[_HELP US FIGHT BACK >>_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60935948:JxSeu6VZN:m:1:3317145305:485F266AB8EC2672254DBDEDDE9AD4D2:r)**
---

I know you're a patriot who supports President Trump, Ron DeSantis, and other conservative leaders.
---
You believed in them and helped them win tough battles when no one thought it was possible.
---
Now, I need you to help me win what will be one of the toughest battles in the country this November.
---
I know something about tough battles. This primary was a tough fight. Fighting and beating breast cancer was a tough fight. Running and growing a Michigan-based steel company, as a woman, was tough. Watching my Nana locked away and left to die in a nursing home was tough.
---
_But as the saying goes, when the times get tough, the tough get going. I am tough, and I am just getting going._
---
With America First patriots like YOU fighting alongside me, we're going to take back our state from the radical Left and lay the groundwork to take back the White House in 2024.
---
The battlelines in this race couldn't be any clearer. This is going to be an epic fight between a conservative businesswoman and mother, and a far-Left birthing parent and career politician.
---
**_To win, I 'm going to need your support, Peter. I don't have liberal megadonors like Whitmer. Grassroots conservatives like you are all I've got. _**
---
**[So please, make a generous contribution of $25, $50, $100, or more to help me FIRE Gretchen Whitmer- and your gift will be 500% MATCHED.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60935948:JxSeu6VZN:m:1:3317145305:485F266AB8EC2672254DBDEDDE9AD4D2:r)**

Thank you,

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Tom Tancredo Formally Endorses Erik
body:
| | | |
---
---
| Representative Tom Tancredo Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Representative Tom Tancredo.

Rep. Tancredo represented Colorado's sixth congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 1999 to 2009.

Tancredo was elected to the Colorado House of Representatives in 1976, where he served three terms. In 1981, Tancredo was appointed by Ronald Reagan to be regional director to the U.S. Department of Education, reappointed by George H.W. Bush. In 2008, as a Congressman, Tancredo decided not to seek re-election and instead ran a presidential campaign centered on the issues of illegal immigration and terrorism.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Tancredo said:
"Erik Aadland demonstrated his patriotism as a decorated combat veteran. We share a deeply abiding love for our country. Erik possesses both the knowledge and the character to fight for meaningful change in Washington. Particularly, he understands that our national security and public safety are vital issues predicated on securing our borders and ending the crisis of uncontrolled mass migration. For these reasons, it is my pleasure to endorse Erik Aadland as the next Congressman from Colorado's 7th district."
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "Rep. Tancredo once said, 'Our Founders were not naive simpletons. They understood that human freedom is a fragile thing, that eternal vigilance is the price of liberty.' It's a wise saying from a wise man, and one with which I agree. Lack of vigilance at the border has led to rampant human and drug trafficking that is claiming many innocent lives. Our leadership is obligated to put a stop to this crisis, and I pledge to be a part of that effort. I am deeply appreciative of Rep. Tancredo's previous work on this issue, and deeply grateful for his endorsement. "
---
---
| |
---
---

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

clean_body: | | | | | Representative Tom Tancredo Endorsement | | | | ---|--- | Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Representative Tom Tancredo. Rep. Tancredo represented Colorado's sixth congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 1999 to 2009. Tancredo was elected to the Colorado House of Representatives in 1976, where he served three terms. In 1981, Tancredo was appointed by Ronald Reagan to be regional director to the U.S. Department of Education, reappointed by George H.W. Bush. In 2008, as a Congressman, Tancredo decided not to seek re-election and instead ran a presidential campaign centered on the issues of illegal immigration and terrorism. | In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Tancredo said: "Erik Aadland demonstrated his patriotism as a decorated combat veteran. We share a deeply abiding love for our country. Erik possesses both the knowledge and the character to fight for meaningful change in Washington. Particularly, he understands that our national security and public safety are vital issues predicated on securing our borders and ending the crisis of uncontrolled mass migration. For these reasons, it is my pleasure to endorse Erik Aadland as the next Congressman from Colorado's 7th district." | | | Erik's Remarks | | | | "Rep. Tancredo once said, 'Our Founders were not naive simpletons. They understood that human freedom is a fragile thing, that eternal vigilance is the price of liberty.' It's a wise saying from a wise man, and one with which I agree. Lack of vigilance at the border has led to rampant human and drug trafficking that is claiming many innocent lives. Our leadership is obligated to put a stop to this crisis, and I pledge to be a part of that effort. I am deeply appreciative of Rep. Tancredo's previous work on this issue, and deeply grateful for his endorsement. " | | | | == | | | About Erik | | | Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. name: American Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0573%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=LfJcvsA%2bMLZnSZwoprDwsw&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39464%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cktDa12vmB%2bSG9y6iF03lw&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Friends,
This week during the primary election in Kansas, Kansans voted overwhelmingly to reject a ballot initiative that would have stripped the right to reproductive health access. Politicians and pundits have expressed their shock and surprise—but those of us who have worked a lifetime championing women’s rights saw this coming.
Even though the former President won Kansas by 15 points, Kansans rejected an abortion ban by more than 20 points. Why does that matter to us here in Virginia? Because while reproductive rights hang in the balance of just one vote in the Senate, I am running against the last anti-choice Democrat in the Virginia State Legislature. I am running to be that vote that ensures the Democrat who has already admitted he’ll join Governor Youngkin’s attempts to restrict reproductive health access, never gets to make that vote on our behalf.
But I can’t do it alone. I need you to champion this cause with me. Here are three important ways you can get involved.
Donate to our campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lashrecse] . We are people funded. I believe public servants must be transparent about where their money comes from, and that begins by fundraising with honesty and integrity.
Join our Policy Committee [https://www.lashrecseaird.com/policyteam] : We’re building a policy platform that is built and powered by the people. I will run on a platform that is representative of what the people of this district want and need and I want your help to build it.
Volunteer for our campaign [https://www.lashrecseaird.com/volunteer] . We are not waiting to meet voters where they are, in-person, virtually or by phone. The time you invest today will all but ensure our victory tomorrow.
Together we will champion women’s health and safety. We will stand up against those undermining our rights and our dignity. Join our committee, volunteer for our campaign, and donate within your capacity. We will win—together.
Sincerely,
Lashrecse

body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Eucli

---|---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvfiodoanue71r5nciolqd6mmomioca95qcgs128_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdh61p33cph2bs)
---
| | That’s why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zf0s6b3k6k86fm27v368psghabsk5jnsvgcboo20_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdh61p33cph2bs)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

And to Voter Protection Project, too.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/20687?t=7&akid=3964%2E878179%2EIJHOX8) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Josh Riley and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/20688?t=8&akid=3964%2E878179%2EIJHOX8)

Who? Glad you asked. Josh was my General Counsel on the Senate Judiciary Committee from 2011 – 2014, and is now running for an open House seat in upstate New York. Even during a period of partisan gridlock, Josh and I successfully got two bills through Congress and signed by the President. One created new rights for survivors of domestic violence. The other provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs.

Josh grew up in Upstate New York in a working-class family. His entire career has been dedicated to making life better for people who don’t have people fighting for them. Get to know Josh and what he stands for [**HERE**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/19824?t=13&akid=3964%2E878179%2EIJHOX8). I was fortunate to have had many, many brilliant, dedicated staffers during my years in the Senate. None was better than Josh. And I can’t think of one who would make a more effective member of Congress.

More often than not, I was the best prepared member of the Judiciary Committee. That’s because I took my work very seriously and so did Josh. That said, we had fun. Please go to his [**website**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/19824?t=14&akid=3964%2E878179%2EIJHOX8) to get to know Josh and what he believes and will be fighting for.

Josh’s seat is a new one, created during redistricting. In a year where every seat will count, this is a tossup district that is a MUST-win for Democrats.

Thanks for your attention.

Al

**P.S.** No other former staff member of mine is running for Congress. So, this is the last one of these!

subject: POLL: Gun Safety Legislation
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic Party of Virginia, www
body:
We’re asking for your thoughts on passing further gun safety legislation to protect Virginians.

|
---
Derek, Back in June, President Joe Biden signed the first major gun safety legislation in 30 years. This legislation keeps convicted domestic abusers from being able to purchase firearms, closing the so-called boyfriend loophole. It also allows for groups to petition courts to remove firearms from someone deemed a threat to themselves or others – popularly known as a red-flag law. But as President Biden said before signing the bill: **“This bill doesn’t do everything I want, [but] it does include actions I’ve long called for that are going to save lives.”** _– President Joe Biden, June 2022_ Derek, there’s still a lot of work to be done. That’s why we’re asking you to take our survey. **[Do you support increased action on gun safety to protect Virginians? When Donald Trump was elected, we feared it would be the end of _Roe v Wade. _When Brett Kavanaugh was appointed, we knew conservatives would have enough votes to get their way. And when the _Dobbs_ opinion leaked in May, our worst fears were confirmed.
But _ NONE_ of that compared to how it felt when _Roe _was actually overturned.
In [my new op-ed in Teen Vogue](https://act.myngp.com/el/yzLES5wOWkFeLNYsIBxXlDWy-Ur4pxjGdYKo-_SPG1Q=/CHeYiyPZLHbqHhpuGo7iRNPQu0AT-ddwey0ByfMiJYI=), I talk about that day -- and all the awful days since.
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/yzLES5wOWkFeLNYsIBxXlDWy-Ur4pxjGdYKo-_SPG1Q=/IWRTQ8woYoAHuDmrzofrlxZk_jgbRae5jTfPPIF8kVQ=)
**At HER Time, we knew that action in November wouldn 't be enough. So we made [the HER Time Guide to a Post-Roe World](https://act.myngp.com/el/yzLES5wOWkFeLNYsIBxXlDWy-Ur4pxjGdYKo-_SPG1Q=/_Ug6se21d05FiEsadvsVvxF0feJbMQwnDjQqkzUfT5k=). It includes two different manuals: one for women looking for safe and reliable abortion resources and one for folks trying to take action for abortion rights.**
You'll hear a lot more about our action guide in weeks to come. For now, I hope you'll take a second to [read my op-ed](https://act.myngp.com/el/yzLES5wOWkFeLNYsIBxXlDWy-Ur4pxjGdYKo-_SPG1Q=/CHeYiyPZLHbqHhpuGo7iRNPQu0AT-ddwey0ByfMiJYI=), [check out our Post-Roe guide](https://act.myngp.com/el/yzLES5wOWkFeLNYsIBxXlDWy-Ur4pxjGdYKo-_SPG1Q=/_Ug6se21d05FiEsadvsVvxF0feJbMQwnDjQqkzUfT5k=), and consider [chipping in to support HER Time's work](https://act.myngp.com/el/yzLES5wOWkFeLNYsIBxXlDWy-Ur4pxjGdYKo-_SPG1Q=/sc6SE1oGMafJvpiujS3AMg-jCODi4zSRqLrUXw1CxmI=?refcode=X_080422_OpEd_B).
In solidarity,
-- _Katie_

name: Hillsdale College via CIntel
subject: Is socialism on the rise?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsghHsEhKN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osghHsEhKN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

A few
years ago, New York magazine posed the question: "When Did
Everyone Become a Socialist?"

This is,
of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left
in America aims to bring about a "Great Reset" of our economy and
our way of life.

In a
recent issue of Imprimis-Hillsdale College's digest of
liberty-author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of
the Great Reset as "'capitalism with Chinese characteristics'-a
two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on
top and socialism for the majority below."

Today, as
a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand
the extent of support for-and opposition to-socialism.

Your
input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight
for the future of liberty in our country.

Will you
please share your views on the political, social, and cultural
forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your
National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/

Sadly,
socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the
young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that...

. . .
during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those
16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also
increased in popularity among all ages.

Why is
this?

Draconian
government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated
competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream
come true for corporate socialists.

At the
same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what
socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures
wherever it has been tried.

This is a
result of the far-Left's "long march through the
institutions"-including colleges and universities, K-12 schools,
and the media.

Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once
confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race
theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as
school boards and even the military.

But it is
in our schools where the effects of critical race theory-which
teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens
according to race-are most dangerous.

You may
recall that many young Americans with college degrees who
championed socialist policies participated in the riots and
violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020.

In the
face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free
markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale's work to reach and
teach millions has never been more urgently needed.

That's
why I need your thoughts quickly.

By
responding to the National Survey on Socialism in the next five
days, your honest opinions will help us understand the recent
rise of socialism and develop our strategy to reach and teach
increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

We hope
to hear from friends representing every part of the country.

Education
is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your
partnership with Hillsdale College is critical.

As
Winston Churchill said, "Socialism is the philosophy of failure,
the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy."

If you
agree, please represent your state and take the National Survey
on Socialism today.

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/

Despite
the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember-it is
NEVER too late to defend liberty through education.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: Will you personally endorse Will’s campaign?
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48779640/359563197/-707005773?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDg1OGY0Ny0xNjE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MdzufW_WZB-hWcHVjD7aD68mPmG0Cc7_G_fjto2K95M=)
Peter,

Our General Election matchup against Ken Calvert is officially in full swing.

From the start, this has been an issues-focused campaign centered on strengthening our democracy so it can work for the American people again – and that message is gaining traction wherever we go.

Will and the team have been working hard to share our vision for CA-41 -- from Corona down to Lake Elsinore and out east to the desert communities of Palm Springs, Rancho Mirage, and Palm Desert.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48779641/359563198/192312732?refcode=em-8.4.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDg1OGY0Ny0xNjE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MdzufW_WZB-hWcHVjD7aD68mPmG0Cc7_G_fjto2K95M=)
It’s been incredible to see how much enthusiasm there is to hold Ken Calvert accountable at the ballot box. The June primary showed us that for the first time in the last decade, Calvert is vulnerable. Democratic turnout was within 2% of surpassing Calvert, and it’s clear he’s headed for the toughest general election fight of his career.

**[We set a goal of locking in 2000 new grassroots endorsements to kick off the general election with strength. Will you add your name to say you personally endorse Will Rollins’ campaign for Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48779642/359563199/935127444?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDg1OGY0Ny0xNjE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MdzufW_WZB-hWcHVjD7aD68mPmG0Cc7_G_fjto2K95M=&emci=12858f47-1614-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=14858f47-1614-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=12636851)**
| **[Add your name](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48779643/359563200/935127444?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDg1OGY0Ny0xNjE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MdzufW_WZB-hWcHVjD7aD68mPmG0Cc7_G_fjto2K95M=&emci=12858f47-1614-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=14858f47-1614-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=12636851)**
---

I know the realities many Western North Carolina families face because I’ve lived them myself.
As a working mom, I know that some days are more of a challenge than others. So many working families I know are feeling the pressure of this time, from rising prices at the pump to juggling the realities of childcare and work.
As a member of the LGBTQ+ community who helped lead the fight for marriage equality in the South, I understand what it means to fight to be equal under the law every single day.
As a pro-choice pastor, I’m committed to protecting reproductive rights and I’m dedicated to ensuring that everyone has the privacy to make choices about their health care.
And as a county commissioner, I understand the real work it takes to get things done for the people of WNC. I’ve led the charge to pass bipartisan policies addressing the opioid crisis and expanding pre-K education. I’m ready to take this same approach on day one in DC.

body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48780849/359565464/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4NGQ3ODQyLTE3MTQtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sQ6_ZmiIVt4pOzxyrIAcAesXVKujv0UHd7WJMGk47Mk=&emci=2cb229c0-7f13-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f84d7842-1714-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) | | | Dear Peter, Before the vote, I wanted to make sure you saw Doug's email below. Our U.S. Senators could hit the floor at any minute to vote on the Inflation Reduction Act. Make no mistake,__this is our chance to pass the most significant climate bill in our nation's history.__ If passed, the bill could cut our country's emissions by a whopping 40% — **but we need all 50 senate Democrats to vote "yes" for it to advance to the House of Representatives.[Will you email our Senators and ask them to keep doing all they can to pass this momentous bill and its wide range of climate protections?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48780851/359565472/1596503070?emci=d32590f4-b112-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=2107230&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4NGQ3ODQyLTE3MTQtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sQ6_ZmiIVt4pOzxyrIAcAesXVKujv0UHd7WJMGk47Mk=)** Thank you, Will Bertellotti, Communications Coordinator, OLCV. ––––– FORWARD ––––– Dear Peter, In an unexpected announcement last week, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer unveiled the most sweeping climate deal to ever reach Congress as part of the Inflation Reduction Act. If passed, this bill would set the United States on a path to lower emissions by close to 40% by 2030. We would not have made it to this moment without your advocacy and the leadership of elected climate champions throughout our nation, like Oregon’s own Senators Ron Wyden and Jeff Merkley. The U.S. Senate is voting any day now, [_**so we need to send our senators one more message thanking them for getting us here and asking them to remain steadfast in the fight to get it passed! **_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48780853/359565477/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4NGQ3ODQyLTE3MTQtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sQ6_ZmiIVt4pOzxyrIAcAesXVKujv0UHd7WJMGk47Mk=&emci=2cb229c0-7f13-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f84d7842-1714-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) While Oregon has fierce environmental advocates in our two U.S. senators fighting for us in the battle against climate change, this is still an urgent ask— the Senate is likely to vote on this bill before the end of the week, with the U.S. House of Representatives’ vote close behind next week. What’s more, is that we will need the vote of all 50 Democratic senators to pass the Inflation Reduction Act and the incredible climate-protecting provisions it includes. [_**Will you email our senators telling them to do everything they can to pass this meaningful climate bill?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48780856/359565478/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4NGQ3ODQyLTE3MTQtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sQ6_ZmiIVt4pOzxyrIAcAesXVKujv0UHd7WJMGk47Mk=&emci=2cb229c0-7f13-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f84d7842-1714-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) If passed, this bill would give the American people: -support and increased accessibility for renewable, electric energy options
-climate goals towards pollution-free electric vehicles that don’t produce unhealthy emissions
-reliable domestic clean energy production
-incentives to pivot from the use of fossil fuels
-investments in environmental justice communities with specific support for working families who often aren’t able to afford the shift away from fossil fuels. Democrats have spent years talking about their role opposing climate change, so now it’s time to turn those words into action by passing this comprehensive bill. Climate champions like Senators Wyden and Merkley have gotten us this far, and we can’t allow Big Oil to stop us now. [_**Let’s show our support for our senators to keep up the battle for our climate and pass the Inflation Reduction Act!**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48780857/359565479/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4NGQ3ODQyLTE3MTQtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sQ6_ZmiIVt4pOzxyrIAcAesXVKujv0UHd7WJMGk47Mk=&emci=2cb229c0-7f13-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f84d7842-1714-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Regrettably, the details settled on between Senators Schumer and Manchin for this climate agreement aren't perfect, but thankfully, the net positives for our climate that would be achieved by passing this bill greatly outweigh the negative. As people across the world and right here in Oregon experience dangerous heat waves and extreme weather conditions, passing this historic deal on climate action can’t come soon enough. [_**Now, we must use our voices by sending a message encouraging our senators to continue spearheading impactful climate action and get this bill passed! **_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/48780861/359565480/1596503070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY4NGQ3ODQyLTE3MTQtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sQ6_ZmiIVt4pOzxyrIAcAesXVKujv0UHd7WJMGk47Mk=&emci=2cb229c0-7f13-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=f84d7842-1714-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) Thank you, Doug Moore, Executive Director, OLCV |

This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. > ICYMI
> Vikram: Unify, Don't Separate America
---
In-Case-You-Missed-It: This week, United States Senate candidate Vikram Mansharamani's op-ed appeared in the Concord Monitor, calling out the Woke Cultural Revolution that is tearing our country apart.
An excerpt of the Op-Ed is below:
Having taught at Harvard for the past five years and Yale for the eight years prior to that, I've had a front-row seat to watch the evolution of our culture on campus. And let me be blunt, it's disturbing.
When I graduated from college, I remember commencement as a celebration of unity, a celebration that brought all together, regardless of religion, skin color or socioeconomic background. The graduation garb was the literal embodiment of commonality. We all wore the same robes, same graduation caps, and same tassles.
Today's graduations emphasize differences rather than similarities. It's now commonplace to have separate graduation ceremonies for students who identify differently. Harvard, for instance, doesn't have one graduation. This year there was a Black graduation, a Native American graduation, and a LatinX graduation (a term that Hispanics detest, by the way). There was also a FirstGen graduation, an APIDA graduation for Asian/Pacific Islander/Desi-Americans, and a Lavender graduation for the LGBTQ+ community.
And Harvard is not alone. This is a growing trend with colleges and universities around the country. Columbia had six "identity-focused" graduations, including an "FLI" graduation for first-generation college graduates and low-income students. Princeton had six, including a Women/Femme graduation and a Pan-African graduation. The list goes on.

I'm going to defeat Marjorie Taylor Greene

|
---
[](https://www.marcusforgeorgia.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzsn0D366fuE1hyM8nYo_dxUewZQ28bweLPNtBsqmgmCjAhwaMb-0B0aaMbvLlc8qYY&e=3c0efca69a2e76c4868c82f23dff8b2a&utm_source=marcusflowers&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=220804_why_fl_1&n=1) Hi, it’s Marcus Flowers, Democratic Army Veteran running for Congress against Marjorie Taylor Greene.

**Here’s what I want you to know about me:** I was born in Troy, Alabama, the birthplace of civil rights icon John Lewis.

I joined the Army right out of high school and served for 27 years overseas as a soldier including a decade fighting in Iraq and Afghanistan.

Service has always been a major part of my life. So when I watched the events of January 6th -- when a Confederate battle flag was paraded through the Capitol rotunda and police officers were beaten with it, I was shocked.

And knowing that my representative, Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene, had actually helped incite the mob that attacked our Capitol, I knew I had to act.

_**The very next day, I resigned my post as a government official and decided to run against her.**_

Since then, our campaign has grown at a record pace, and we’ve out-raised Marjorie Taylor Greene for three consecutive quarters.

I know we can win, flip this seat, and send Marjorie Taylor Greene into political retirement. But it’s going to take a MASSIVE team effort to do it.

[**So with less than 100 days remaining in this campaign, I need to ask you to dig deep: Can you chip in $20 or more to help my campaign finish what it started and DEFEAT Marjorie Taylor Greene once and for all?**](https://www.marcusforgeorgia.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzsn0D366fuE1hyM8nYo_dxUewZQ28bweLPNtBsqmgmCjAhwaMb-0B0aaMbvLlc8qYY&e=3c0efca69a2e76c4868c82f23dff8b2a&utm_source=marcusflowers&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=220804_why_fl_1&n=2)

Thanks to him, we have the third highest unemployment rate in the country. Contrasting this, is Liberal and Pro-Amnesty Anna Paulina Luna in her own words, stating she “always agreed with President Obama’s immigration policies”. Luna puts her views on full display by promoting a “pathway to citizenship” and providing amnesty for illegal immigrants.

[](https://hayslettforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1bed80455017e0c6f06266c32&id=7b8ded4264&e=c927abcf3e)

Anna Paulina Luna is a pro-amnesty, Obama-loving liberal.

| | Peter, Did you see this? Joe Biden has officially OK’d a new version of his plan to remake America. Biden calls it “Build Back Better,” but you know that’s a lie.

I want to share FIVE ways Biden's Build Back Better hurts Americans:
---
| |
* Spends $64 billion to prop up the failed Obamacare system.

* Wastefully spends $369 billion on D.C. special interests—this will prolong the inflation crisis.

* Imposes soviet-style price-controls on prescription drugs—this will reduce new R&D; for medications.

* Creates higher healthcare costs for the 82% of Americans not on medicare.

* Raises $739 billion in new taxes on the American economy during a recession!

---
| | This is actually the THIRD version of the Build Back Better plan that Biden has tried to pass. **We’ve successfully defeated it TWICE before, and we’ll do it again!**

“ _Sorry Joe. Three strikes and you’re out!”_

Biden has the whole corporate media spin machine lying for him. The entire Biden camp is trying to redefine what a “recession” is, so they can say America isn’t in one.

**But numbers are stubborn things.** Unfortunately, our economy shrank for two quarters in a row. At a time like this, America needs pro-growth policies. Biden is doing the opposite.

Biden wants to raise taxes—to the tune of $739 billion. Biden wants to spend your money on his friends, the Washington class of D.C. special interests. Biden wants to prop up the failed Obamacare system.

**None of this will build America back better.** It would increase inflation, raise the cost of health care, and take more money out of your wallet each and every month!
---

| | Extending Obamacare subsidies is a blatant attempt to dole out cash to politically favored constituencies ahead of an election. The crisis is one of Democrats’ own creation: they added extra subsidies to Obamacare plans as part of the trillions of COVID spending dollars. **Now, the program is set to expire before the midterms, and voters will see the true cost of their healthcare in the midst of Biden’s disastrous economy, which has already brought record-high price increases.** The inflation rate is now at 9.1%, the highest figure in four decades, and gas and simple groceries are becoming totally unaffordable:
---
| |
* Gas is up 60%
* Eggs are up 33%
* Butter is up 21%
* Flour is up 19%
* Milk is up 16%

---

Fellow American,

Every morning I wake up, determined to get the most out of each day. I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one.

But I've got to tell you, MSNBC and their cast of far-Left characters do their best to ruin my day as often as they can. You might recall that earlier this year one of their regular panelists began attacking our Senate campaign.

In April, he called me an **"ignorant neophyte,"** and said that my candidacy is **"a white insult to Black people."**

Then he called Senator Tim Scott and me _**"tokens"**_ who are _**"shucking and jiving for their white handlers."** _

Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week:

| _**"Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their negroes: to do what they're told."**_
---

I'll repeat what I said in April: **this is racist, disgusting, and sad.**

What's also disturbing is that our opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. _Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so._

_**Senator Warnock's silence is deafening and disappointing.**_

| | Friends, We are living in an upside down world — I don’t have to tell you how bad it is. Instead of finding commonsense solutions to fix the many crises facing our nation, Backwards Biden is purposefully making matters worse and colluding with Nancy Pelosi and her woke mob in Congress to transform our nation. name: Laura Nevitt,  Keystone Progress
subject: PA, you can still vote by mail!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Keystone Progress Education Fund, www
body:
Dear Friend,

We actually had some great news in PA this week.

The state’s Supreme Court is allowing all voters to cast ballots by mail, despite lawmakers’ efforts to squash voters’ rights with Act 77.

We are so grateful that the court overturned a lower court’s rulings in this critical moment for democracy in this swing state. Baseless attacks on the integrity of mail-in voting by Trump and his cronies have created doubts around our electoral system. This is how they are angling to take our votes and steal our elections. This shows us that when we vote in all elections and advocate for voters, we can win.

Keystone is focused on mobilizing progressives to vote in coming elections so that we can protect our democracy while our rights are under great threat by (ironically!) elected officials.

Support our movement by donating today! The best way to help is by signing up below for a recurring monthly donation. Sign up now.
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progressive-monthly?refcode=080422]

Your regular giving will keep progressives in PA thriving until the November midterms when everything is on the table!

Thank you!

Laura Nevitt

I know you've been with us since the beginning of United Rural Democrats, and that's why I trust your judgment. It's also why I know I can give you a sneak peek at our plan for this month, and how we're going to organize Democratic wins in November. Peter, here's our plan for the month of August. First, we're planning to traverse the country, visiting as many rural towns as we can to get the word out about Democratic candidates and priorities. Many rural Americans feel that Democrats have left them behind, and we need to show voters that Democrats are working to cut them in on the deal. Next, we need to lift up the Democratic candidates who are running in rural districts. We started this last month by endorsing a number of candidates across the country. Now, we need to continue this work by making sure they have the resources they need to win in November. Finally, we need to expose our GOP opponents for their failures to support rural Americans. Republicans have reversed the tide on progress, plunging rural America into the dark on issues like education, voting rights, and environmental issues. Peter - let me know what you think about our three-point plan. You are part of this movement, and we need your support and input on how we can best reach our rural communities. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: We need your support now more than ever, Peter. – Joe Shepherd, President of United Rural Democrats United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. If we're going to take back our country, we need a 50-state strategy to organize in every community across the country. Will you support our network of activists on the ground as we work to rebuild our party's infrastructure and flip these areas blue?

Derek,

There are less than 100 days until Election Day so we want to be clear:

Georgia.

Brian Kemp passed a radical law that makes it harder for Georgians —

criminalized handing out food and water directly to voters waiting in long
lines and placed an unnecessary limit on ballot drop boxes.

We can overcome these efforts — but only if we have a grassroots team
powering us every step of the way.

Team, We’re proud to share that the Senate passed the _Sergeant First Class Heath Robinson Honoring Our Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics (PACT) Act,_ bipartisan legislation ensuring Arizona veterans exposed to toxic substances during service have access to the care they’ve earned. Kyrsten originally helped introduce and cosponsored several bills that inspired this bipartisan effort — including the _Health Care For Burn Pit Veterans Act,_ which is an essential building block of the _PACT Act_. The _PACT Act_ provides access to health care for at least 1 million veterans who served in post-9/11 combat roles and were potentially exposed to toxic substances. Until now, they were unable to get the benefits they earned. We’ve always been able to count on our team to be strong advocates for Arizona veterans, and we look forward to our bipartisan bill becoming law. subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm7oockpdr6a21imq6vh8qevlqpd0pofa5j7f9bo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56egn4tblm1on4t1kmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf4pdjcqqb1cb5edrm3dj0ehr63dr569r3ctbmeer61cb3m8qj6ctncupbac3gs1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8omcs9imdijfdr2coq61cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdim9or6ctge4o324no)
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2kh5n1k4rsj4jtf539j6i1dcm75sgifasqpvoqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0v8oo08ivf1f188f3h2renvu9hq66dnpkci855o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8f7shb9u71q26ia8l6r2mq85m0dp1fgebgoevdo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zedb29ifctl4578j1pgl9iqrltv8dgbc4eukok2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zafpmkh7dpfe47u9b010d534qtcbq4hvfstuf9bg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ztrl4sf8lpl7o0ul4ck4rbekqk44eavm5pb12qu8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd9f0jujeoa52t9brfghgmth0a9kubfh8v6sluh8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zonljngmsv4hcrm09g66fpuvls8qhs1as3n9lha0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.

This is personal to me.

I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zs61mi9a39lf4sg9m5jco6lms1vvnt9fas8dfjlo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1rd6jv44jpots3t93qt9m0vohrli2cjp9d0idj0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z38ab8ldt0g1te10i010tf1aue7uhucgb5fbcisg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6kg67jbh0sfpg1n8qh5njravhd0kaqs316c808o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjdjf3qfdhk8vkbeuu28knct3s19p1hvq5li3kog_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6svcpcql4n975m1mkr7uj34f626175sccr11ldo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zevao41q3jup5s490uaqcccf1gelmte49nu7m030_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7k0jj21btfefrouv4kpritip8eeb1mk8hdig620_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3ehfd4cmi7ub92uivirase0atd60ts7ke1eg5no_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

This is my last message to you before you close this email.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment.

My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause.

[_**Please consider making the most generous donation you can today by clicking here.**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3reft3l3gu2h6sdrrcr0fis30msoon2cka7op7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdj6eo72c1h2bs)

Thank you, Friend.

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I 'm not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend.
