name: Ron DeSantis
subject: FL Strikes Back Against the Woke Mob
body:
| | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60934921:6G8Aw6VNY:m:1:3253819041:E05F901D3C1486650F143877C3A0881F:r)
---
Peter, Our enemy is out of the shadows, and they are not limiting their attack on our values and our culture to the halls of government. We've seen the woke mob attack institution by institution as they look for more ways to impose their radical agenda on the American people.

The target today? Infiltrating the American companies and finding ways to make them bow to their will.

The new movement, the so-called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), is infiltrating boardrooms across the country. But don't let its banal name fool you -- it's a concerted effort to get companies to make decisions based on how closely they align with liberal orthodoxy even when it's not in the best interest of consumers, employees, or shareholders.
**[PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60934921:6G8Aw6VNY:m:1:3253819041:E05F901D3C1486650F143877C3A0881F:r "PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>")**
The Left has conditioned its mob, everyone from anarchists who toss Molotov cocktails at police to its army of woke Twitter zombies, to raise their pitchforks at any company who dares to defy them.

And it's working. Whether they are hostages or collaborators, companies and CEOs are bowing to this pressure. They're going woke. _**And the consequences are dire.**_

As Governor, I'm making sure we fight back. This isn't just about politics. There are real lives being hurt by this. **Teachers, first responders, and people who have trusted the state of Florida with their pensions are seeing their savings and their future eroded in the interest of a group of **_**Left-wing activists who couldn 't run a lemonade stand.**_

We made a great stride here at home, and I think it can be a model for how other states start standing up for their citizens over the radical Left's agenda. Now, in Florida, we've prohibited state fund managers from investing the state of Florida's money based on political factors.

We want them to invest the state's money in the best interest of the beneficiaries of those funds, and we are going to require fund managers to only consider maximizing the return on investment on behalf of Florida's retirees. That's what the people of Florida deserve.
**[AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60934921:6G8Aw6VNY:m:1:3253819041:E05F901D3C1486650F143877C3A0881F:r "AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>")**
**But we didn 't stop there.** We also took aim at one of the Left's favorite new forms of censorship: preventing access to financial services. That's right, the new move is to make it painful for banks or payment processors like Visa or PayPal to do business with groups they don't like. They want to choke off the ability of businesses they don't agree with from being able to buy and sell goods.

That's not happening in Florida. I'm not letting Wall Street banks or credit card companies discriminate against people for any religious, political, or social beliefs. The reality is every time the economy is politicized, the end result is more market share for monopolistic legacy operators and crushing burdens on the small- and medium-sized business whose survival is critical to our communities and to our entrepreneurial spirit as a nation. This is as much an attack on the little guy and on the average consumer as it is an attack on conservatism.

These reforms seem simple, right? Common sense. I think so, too. But it hasn't stopped the Left from attacking me. That's why I had to write you today.

The Left has captured a lot of ground, and they've gotten many companies to agree to their demands, and with that complicity comes a great deal of money. The money being spent to stop what we're doing in Florida and to keep conservative victories like this from happening is immense. Every faceless liberal alphabet group you can think of, along with George Soros and Hollywood liberals, are spending money to defeat me while the legacy corporate media fabricates lies and half-truths to try and paint our successes - successes that look like common sense to average Americans - as the radical position.

I have no doubt that the Left will spend MILLIONS trying to stop me from being re-elected. They want you and every other Republican and conservative in the country to sit down and shut up. To stop standing up for conservative principles. To stop advancing the cause of individual liberty. That's why I need your help. That's why I need you to donate today. We need to be able to fully fund the defense against the woke mob.

Florida has led the way on some of the most critical issues to conservatives over the last few years.
* **Fighting the Fauci fanatics.**
* **Keeping kids in schools and businesses open.**
* **Funding our police and standing up for them when they needed it most.**
* **Standing up for a secure border by fighting the wave of illegal immigrants being dropped in our communities by a federal government that was asleep at the wheel.**

The list goes on. But the bottom line is that the left knows if they beat us in Florida, the message will be sent that GOP Governors better not try to lead for fear of a tsunami of liberal cash that will lie, cheat, and steal until they can kick real conservatives out of office.**

_No matter the cost, I have no intention of backing down._

**I hope you'll make a donation today so that we can keep up the fight. The liberal establishment is going to throw everything it can at us.** [I hope you'll be there with me to fight back.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60934921:6G8Aw6VNY:m:1:3253819041:E05F901D3C1486650F143877C3A0881F:r "I hope you’ll be there with me to fight back.")

**Sincerely, __

Friend,

On Monday, we learned that the annual Music Midtown festival, a major economic engine for the City of Atlanta, will be canceled. The reason?

**Organizers of the festival had serious concerns about their ability to keep artists and tens of thousands of concertgoers safe in the wake of Georgia laws that weaken gun safety regulations.** [****](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48790041/359584456/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_220804MT_N_JJ_FULL_5_G_N_P1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYmY2NTI4OS0yNTE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=u0f3D8ts5A9bDybXM7ItBFaSYq8qpzT64O9HlcS2JJo=) Make no mistake: the cancellation of Music Midtown is a huge loss for Georgia's music industry and its economy. It illustrates that extremist laws (like the permitless carry law passed earlier this year) are not only dangerous but bad for business.

GOP leaders in this state — including my opponent, Chris Carr — have proven that they won’t put public safety ahead of the gun lobby. Now, this apparently extends to the pocketbooks of ordinary Georgians.

We need an Attorney General who will fight for common-sense gun safety. Unlike Chris Carr, I vigorously opposed the permitless carry bill. subject: The Democrat Spin Zone
body:
To view this email as a web page, go to the link below, or copy and paste it into your browser's address window.
https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=50fb1d1963b9fc65c9977e2d548d4d1df2686f601b5d9b8c5db81c459fdc7bce1985f7cba77a910477aedb566bd7f805821c0658ae735a2cd25c9ff1e8950b6a880555eb7900e0fecb60e19af9acac50

Peter,

To call the trajectory of our nation under the Biden administration “disastrous” would be an understatement. Joe Biden has failed Americans at every turn and Democrats have been complicit in his destruction of our country.

Biden’s failures are so glaring that his administration is past the point of explaining away his missteps to the American people. They are now actively changing definitions to spin the truth in favor of their false narratives.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=ca7caab650237e4165cc292d6c19565cc1233a933b39d37577f63a966a320616e0414eb295267f1e3315c5ef23a38c15465ad469bc8247ea
[REJECT THE LEFT’S DISTORTION OF TRUTH]

As a leader, you can’t simply manipulate your way to success. Instead of attempting to correct course and right his many wrongs in office, Biden is now just rewriting history — but Floridians aren't falling for it.

Just like we didn’t fall for their change in narrative on their description of the “mostly peaceful protests” occurring as cities burned to the ground, or declaring our southern border “secure” at the same time that our country is experiencing more illegal border crossings than ever before, or changing the definition of woman to pander to the woke ideological playbook.

This isn’t anything new for the Biden administration or his corporate media lapdogs. They’ve been backtracking and running cover for Biden’s failures since he entered the Oval Office. It doesn’t take an expert to know that the crisis at our southern border is just that — a crisis. But you’ll never hear that term come from the White House or those reporting on the matter.

Legacy media outlets actually sent an internal memo directing staffers to not call the record amount of illegal border crossings and floods of fentanyl into our state and country a crisis. They must be exhausted from constantly spinning on Biden’s never ending hamster wheel of redefining and story shifting and backtracking they’ve done in the past few years — we know the American people certainly are.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=ca7caab650237e4165cc292d6c19565cc1233a933b39d37577f63a966a320616e0414eb295267f1e3315c5ef23a38c15465ad469bc8247ea
[END THE MADNESS]

The limit to the Left’s maniacal demolition of anything that doesn’t fit their twisted version of reality does not exist. As Floridians and Americans, we must stand up against this war on reality waged by a party so hellbent on power they can no longer recognize the difference between right and wrong.

Governor DeSantis will always stand for the truth. There is no room for changing narratives and altering history in positions of leadership. And that is the difference between a leader and the Democrat Machine. Leaders seek the path that benefits the people they serve. The political Left seeks the path that benefits themselves.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=ca7caab650237e4165cc292d6c19565cc1233a933b39d37577f63a966a320616e0414eb295267f1e3315c5ef23a38c15465ad469bc8247ea
[STAND AGAINST THE TYRANNICAL LEFT]

Democrats can continue on their woke rampage of redefining reality all they want, but they will never be able to rewrite the way Americans have been impacted by their bad policy. Come November, you have a choice: freedom or tyranny. Governor DeSantis’s number one priority is to put freedom first for all Floridians.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=ca7caab650237e4165cc292d6c19565cc1233a933b39d37577f63a966a320616e0414eb295267f1e3315c5ef23a38c15465ad469bc8247ea
Will you join him?

For Freedom,

Team DeSantis

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=ca7caab650237e4165cc292d6c19565cc1233a933b39d37577f63a966a320616e0414eb295267f1e3315c5ef23a38c15465ad469bc8247ea

body:
I’ll repeat what I said before: this is racist, disgusting, and sad. |
---
Fellow American,

Every morning I wake up, determined to get the most out of each day. I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one.

But I've got to tell you, MSNBC and their cast of far-Left characters do their best to ruin my day as often as they can. You might recall that earlier this year one of their regular panelists began attacking our Senate campaign.

In April, he called me an **"ignorant neophyte,"** and said that my candidacy is **"a white insult to Black people."**

Then he called Senator Tim Scott and me _**"tokens"**_ who are _**"shucking and jiving for their white handlers."** _

Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week:

| _**"Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their negroes: to do what they're told."**_
---

I'll repeat what I said in April: **this is racist, disgusting, and sad.**

What's also disturbing is that our opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. _Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so._

_**Senator Warnock's silence is deafening and disappointing.**_

clean_body: I’ll repeat what I said before: this is racist, disgusting, and sad. | Fellow American, Every morning I wake up, determined to get the most out of each day. I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one. But I've got to tell you, MSNBC and their cast of far-Left characters do their best to ruin my day as often as they can. You might recall that earlier this year one of their regular panelists began attacking our Senate campaign. In April, he called me an "ignorant neophyte," and said that my candidacy is "a white insult to Black people." Then he called Senator Tim Scott and me "tokens" who are "shucking and jiving for their white handlers." Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week: | "Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their negroes: to do what they're told." I'll repeat what I said in April: this is racist, disgusting, and sad. What's also disturbing is that our opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so. Senator Warnock's silence is deafening and disappointing. The loudest and clearest way to push back against these kinds of disgusting attacks is to defeat them at the ballot box. Enough is enough. name: Aadland For Congress
subject: Erik WAS going to be a counselor...
body:
Then duty called once again.
| | | |
---
---
|
# We Can Do Better
---
|
---
---
| | |
---|---
|
Public opinion of Washington is rightfully low after years of corruption, dishonesty, and manipulation. Time and again, we have been lied to by career politicians who will say anything to be reelected. They accomplish nothing they promise; their beautiful yet empty speeches give way to a different side of themselves once they maintain their incumbency.

We can do better. It's time for us to elect individuals of character and compassion who understand their role as public servants.

In 2021, I finished my master's degree in Depth Psychology. My desire was to be a counselor to those needing help, assisting them in finding a path leading to healing. However, while pursuing my PhD, I began to see how lost and broken the world as a whole was becoming. Realizing that I needed to effect change for more than one person at a time, I felt a call to serve our community by getting involved in politics.

In counseling as in politics, things can get a bit messy before healing can begin. That is why I am ready to address complexity in issues and advocate for sound policy. From my military service, to my time in the energy industry, to my education in the mental health space, and now in the many hours I spend on the campaign trail, my number one priority has always been to make a difference and to help those around me.

I will go to Congress as a servant leader and a peacemaker, bringing people together to get things done for Colorado. I will bring compassion and understanding to Washington according to the first principles of human flourishing that I have studied, and I will uphold truth and integrity in every decision I make.

I never designed my life to run for public office, but my experiences have nonetheless prepared me for this great endeavor. Send me to Washington, and I will be the uniter that Colorado families deserve.

This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. It's time for us to elect individuals of character and compassion who understand their role as public servants. In 2021, I finished my master's degree in Depth Psychology. My desire was to be a counselor to those needing help, assisting them in finding a path leading to healing. However, while pursuing my PhD, I began to see how lost and broken the world as a whole was becoming. Realizing that I needed to effect change for more than one person at a time, I felt a call to serve our community by getting involved in politics. In counseling as in politics, things can get a bit messy before healing can begin. That is why I am ready to address complexity in issues and advocate for sound policy. From my military service, to my time in the energy industry, to my education in the mental health space, and now in the many hours I spend on the campaign trail, my number one priority has always been to make a difference and to help those around me. I will go to Congress as a servant leader and a peacemaker, bringing people together to get things done for Colorado. I will bring compassion and understanding to Washington according to the first principles of human flourishing that I have studied, and I will uphold truth and integrity in every decision I make. name: Cecile Richards
subject: It's shameful
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
I know that together we can do this.
#
Hi, it's Cecile.
Last week, the U.S. Supreme Court cleared the way for Greg Abbott’s extreme trigger law to go into effect. **That means that on August 25th, abortion will be illegal in Texas with no exception for rape or incest.**
My mother would be horrified to know that a right all Texans had when she was governor has been eliminated by Greg Abbott and others who are only focused on control and power.
It's shameful. My mother taught me how important it was to fight for what's right — that's why I joined this campaign as National Finance Chair. Because Texans need new leadership.
Greg Abbott has failed to keep Texans safe from a deadly pandemic, failing power grid, and gun violence — and now he's eliminated our right to basic reproductive health care. **No more.**
If the Supreme Court is going to leave it up to the states to decide who has control over a woman's body, then we MUST elect a governor in Texas who believes in a woman's freedom to make her own decisions about her own body, health care, and future. There's no other option.
So I'm asking:
**[Will you contribute $3 or more now directly toward Beto's campaign to defeat Greg Abbott? Future generations are counting on us.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220804-1.xZG-Y_&refcode=ema20220804-201543&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=201543%2E444211%2EuvPkFP)**
**[Donate Now »](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220804-1.xZG-Y_&refcode=ema20220804-201543&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=201543%2E444211%2EuvPkFP)**
As difficult as this moment is, I find hope in this people-powered movement for change. In the over 79,000 people who are volunteering to unseat Abbott and the hundreds of thousands of individual contributors to Beto's campaign.
I know that together we can do this.
Thank you,
Cecile

#
Derek,
We’re really gonna miss Senator Pat Toomey. (LOL just kidding)
_Senator who?_ Uhhh... This dude. 👇

**I’m sure you already know how bad Pat Toomey is.**
In the last few weeks alone, Toomey has refused to say if he’ll support a bill protecting marriage equality and delayed a bill that would guarantee life-saving care for veterans harmed by burn pits and toxins.
As Jon Stewart said, Pat Toomey used our veterans as “pawns.” That’s just sickening.
And please keep in mind, this dude’s been in the Senate for 11 years!!! I don’t think I could even fit all of his BS into one email, frankly. 🙄🙄🙄
But the #1 thing you need to know about Pat Toomey is this: **He is NOT seeking re-election, which is why I’m now running against Dr. Oz to win Pennsylvania’s open Senate seat.**
So, today, I’m humbly asking:
**[_Will you please make your first donation of $5 or more toward our people-powered campaign? This is our chance to replace Pat Toomey with a fighter for working families + add Pennsylvania’s open Senate seat to our razor-thin Democratic majority._](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220804-1?refcode=em20220804-6738&refcode2=6738_434096_8mto28&akid=6738%2E434096%2E8mto28)**

__
The last time this Senate seat was contested, it ended up being the most expensive Senate race of the 2016 campaign cycle.
So, with how crucial (and flippable) this seat is, **we know the GOP is willing to spend as much money as possible to make sure we don’t win.** After all, Dr. Oz is literally worth $100-$400 million thanks to his years hawking snake oil on TV. | Dear Friend,
Did you see the recent news story touting "rising stars" in the state Legislature?
Among them:

* legislators who worked to prevent favorable US Supreme Court decisions from being adopted here in Massachusetts;

* legislators who passed the bill to give driver's licenses to illegal immigrants; and,

* a state representative who argued strongly against religious exemptions from vaccine mandates.

This is what's wrong with our Legislature -- our elected officials have all the wrong priorities! They keep looking for ways to spend your hard-earned tax dollars instead of giving you your money back. And, let's not forget: on the very same day a passenger escaped a burning MBTA subway car by jumping into a river, legislators weren't trying to make the T zero-failure, they were looking to make it zero-emissions.
We need to stop the insanity! I'm running for Lieutenant Governor because I'm concerned by what I see. I'm running to be on your side when it comes to issues like protecting your tax dollars, respecting your rights and freedom, and keeping your kids safe.
Are you with me? If so, I'd really appreciate your help.

One thing I've learned as a public figure is that I have a duty to use my power for the greater good.

We are at a crucial point in our country.
Across America, we're seeing unprecedented attacks on our fundamental rights. Our democracy is being threatened, and I feel an incredible responsibility to speak out.
That's why I'm reaching out to you today.
Growing up, my parents were very politically engaged. I used to sit in the back of their station wagon, handing out pamphlets for our candidates.
And while that station wagon is long gone, I'm staying engaged by writing to express how important it is that we reelect Maggie Hassan in New Hampshire this November.

Senator Hassan has worked tirelessly to make this country more inclusive and accessible to all Americans, and we can't afford to lose her voice in the Senate.

But Mitch McConnell only needs to flip one seat to take back control of the Senate, and he's all in on flipping this one. If McConnell takes back the Senate, he will block critical legislation on voting rights, health care, reproductive rights, and more, forcing our country back decades.

name: Candace Owens, Co-founder of BLEXIT
subject: The most personal email I’ve ever sent you
body:
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34a9590cd6304fc5a2ba571d74396b89&_e=-Ul0QrS1Np0xkwy0pRf91URjiJ4F-JY_xRwZhbLyU-2GvYPO-8vnmeUdEUKT9I7tfcbZJoXJd9E9QflqyD3gWmG7DtaHg1zCfqgFdKE7SvH7HW7xDADkf8UQhjWHd16rbRp7D0UVjzrZ3sMq5KgSipy2cJk0KYgc4QHrSZXxd2d26OT_Y0gOzDqlQWGpg0Tz6HwYCUYH0HaqZ2VymZy3wXnbGiQfxXbgYkqqTXrkPBHwoD8jaxgkE7G4PNqp_b1paf1pbgYmVL9gKsFZ9oKveluJIgPavVrrajWepfgT0nLUPsPgeFUPAPl-knqgOh_N7EFRoEog1hfu_iObTARWa4zfLIrh6zcyYXsAs6cg1DQ%3D)

Friend,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation’s mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34a9590cd6304fc5a2ba571d74396b89&_e=-Ul0QrS1Np0xkwy0pRf91URjiJ4F-JY_xRwZhbLyU-2GvYPO-8vnmeUdEUKT9I7tfcbZJoXJd9E9QflqyD3gWmG7DtaHg1zCfqgFdKE7SvH7HW7xDADkf8UQhjWHd16rbRp7D0UVjzrZ3sMq5KgSijO7UbPrVIqHT-vMI36IRb3UlqkHnv_OQPLIZ1I3Z9CzlobqRdQEB9qcSUgM3YllEs5mI2np5vwetTGivJjS3VtxJ0JXN8xqyPwQKixJwiMCrwz1JBYORO3uSgwtLN-96TGFmpkNouDbbbcxVDrK0nQtuLiLroQhpwc8Ao7e7MEq1oTTtDTYVphY-Jil8OE8hhAAaWgQvD9wYM_-8iJ1JoA%3D)

**_Now I’ll share my story_ ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I’ve dealt with racism... _**I’ve even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Friend, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34a9590cd6304fc5a2ba571d74396b89&_e=-Ul0QrS1Np0xkwy0pRf91URjiJ4F-JY_xRwZhbLyU-2GvYPO-8vnmeUdEUKT9I7tfcbZJoXJd9E9QflqyD3gWmG7DtaHg1zCfqgFdKE7SvH7HW7xDADkf8UQhjWHd16rbRp7D0UVjzrZ3sMq5KgSipq2bedTwO3tiCRl4KKaCbJgeaY7N9_ypZCRpt36RjTeBnmNhhDBhGU1WecruUmNAQu9UnkZ0aZ7zFJa9ikIrNzNKgP99quzTYCwdQDOuWEIUGmlBZTCFqNjNRn5m9C8yb8mBupW-MDAR1Z6BNwflIORnwFnJw7SEuPhz-wDGeXhyGM4ub0pj16Lh-YOVHkPJ3JEeN9k3cpnk-YbVopGh64%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I’m not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT’s efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34a9590cd6304fc5a2ba571d74396b89&_e=-Ul0QrS1Np0xkwy0pRf91URjiJ4F-JY_xRwZhbLyU-2GvYPO-8vnmeUdEUKT9I7tfcbZJoXJd9E9QflqyD3gWmG7DtaHg1zCfqgFdKE7SvH7HW7xDADkf8UQhjWHd16rbRp7D0UVjzrZ3sMq5KgSiiRouBigqNsCuwKdgylkwG8_lRtP4qCCU7H2WIKk-qFLgg7jfv-OZPBVvn7jV5ViH1KatTmevbaiimwOsqivZ6bPrOIe0_b76izSKdRfslIhsDne1s-uXR7Qyf37WfcX8Lf1pDLjt5B_IeTcx_RHO19iAh_HbAjRmKX2fqOJGJM87hdwPHA78X99d9duNjZfOf-QSA7khgXsEivfiQY7AH0%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34a9590cd6304fc5a2ba571d74396b89&_e=-Ul0QrS1Np0xkwy0pRf91URjiJ4F-JY_xRwZhbLyU-2GvYPO-8vnmeUdEUKT9I7tfcbZJoXJd9E9QflqyD3gWmG7DtaHg1zCfqgFdKE7SvH7HW7xDADkf8UQhjWHd16rbRp7D0UVjzrZ3sMq5KgSipS0OpuNt3g3HlaW1i42D_BLAZa0JHmH1QDZGQB5lOlLVHZgNNXytH9Obpd6S4UFqKO_uPzCveScstTVHKprVLK7wYQ3xw6ovfWcfivQ3ePeDbL0UOtI59TDCv_JJvOr4LJJuYLh2IG_NagSTr-ih29wCRCwecYtfip28grUvbu2z8FAvXFpxjY4sitDLXd5BRUEkTlZRewNrPVU1ZNM1R4%3D)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34a9590cd6304fc5a2ba571d74396b89&_e=-Ul0QrS1Np0xkwy0pRf91URjiJ4F-JY_xRwZhbLyU-2GvYPO-8vnmeUdEUKT9I7tfcbZJoXJd9E9QflqyD3gWmG7DtaHg1zCfqgFdKE7SvH7HW7xDADkf8UQhjWHd16rbRp7D0UVjzrZ3sMq5KgSigM9MSmaQ88c9VgCZOlg5rEsu_6YkkPUrDl6AorgAPbGkVqfY5EudPSs_UdksQtJWuFkCTfBc6PsUL7cE_ujslgqrv8gVNvlNrP2YuiaOxiWWNXED03zSVG0Aihif9zFCSbZ4muqH2aSSj4zTqGQqxEEAuJjEURcPvPBTXZPbCVrvH2CtUbJzkDi2b_xmgJfm1eEsSxVB2rd40pGIc13LE0%3D)

* **Teaching History: **Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=34a9590cd6304fc5a2ba571d74396b89&_e=-Ul0QrS1Np0xkwy0pRf91URjiJ4F-JY_xRwZhbLyU-2GvYPO-8vnmeUdEUKT9I7tfcbZJoXJd9E9QflqyD3gWmG7DtaHg1zCfqgFdKE7SvH7HW7xDADkf8UQhjWHd16rbRp7D0UVjzrZ3sMq5KgSiiPTW144wDe71Z_u4Ed2yuaHJFFwCjCoI6v4qiqZ6pttRAdbjHIkT5_SKN1B95WVdqFocd72K9XVpPj0ilLhojlwF4svFX1rTngD_3nwrDWQuZ1xM_1JBKP34MCAg0Br8ocZCYfx0S4v-gfrT4QvKbcKvkOyikLFNsS37PpFskWkyoNNq80tx76T5NGCdNlQYX6Rhi0UsLqNGGe7vY2eg2c%3D)

* **Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. clean_body: Friend, This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation. Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation. For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop. In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. Now I’ll share my story ... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities. Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how “helpless” I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking. We’re taught to believe we’re victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals. This is WRONG. I’ve dealt with racism... I’ve even received death threats. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable. But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up. I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. I am breaking the rules. It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... I’m not doing that. You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country. So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don’t want to miss). When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a “think tank”, but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting “DO-tank”. We’re doing things no other organization in the country is doing. Here are the BLEXIT Foundation’s values, what we’re doing to reach Black communities, and what we’re fighting for: School Choice: Often, the people allegedly “fighting for minorities” are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools. The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. Criminal Justice Reform: The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities. Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message. Entrepreneurship: I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire. BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we’re actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. Teaching History: Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Presenting Our Message: **We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we’ve allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore. The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We’re hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We’re not just preaching to the choir, and these aren’t boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. What does “BLEXIT” mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor. This is personal to me. I was once a slave to a culture of victimhood and became a proud Black patriot. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today: This is my last message to you before you close this email. The BLEXIT Foundation believes in faith, family, and freedom. At the end of the day, our message to urban communities is about love and empowerment. My burning desire is to use my voice and change the direction of our urban communities and the country. The BLEXIT Foundation has a real impact, and I am inviting you to join our cause. Thank you, Friend. Candace Owens President BLEXIT Foundation Sent to Reclaiming American Freedom subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

body:
This will be the most important race in the entire country...Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b2abcf803a8e4fbfa0ac81867f655c45&_e=eiGQwHBUDJTV74lZBCbYKgNNDfAX9PNQNXEM2xZhSGjZjPBj0W8AJ-c_yQA4uYsXdbQtcxF6wSZPD-4wJaSlvd9ITy7GnosDNXT7U5eDy2ytviXmzgV8W3cCjMf3Z3XxN-Yn3SamfPvDcgjNA0RR-0XSlp9efXebz9Hd-ELGY1oOmvHhaTlToYsEgaqoomuCeYbGaFx22xgAsFxgRCB6UB-BaJjx4PzVmNGKQ6p8c3JLDRbIiminHYsxCoH_8iQuuH4WXZwbBfOUrIiIoIvHtOSyc2QJjv7kE4TwWe4rLW9rpyve2cEFcDpwlz2TLKiEIsNzHuPQjAtUL96z0oaC7ofogXFFReIZrVTGh41FOe7vyGH0g1MI2l7ujyNDvhtl-jTo1J18mfD88lvn48hneELVD2vnyZrj1QoOclUHaTNF1dJmwdDrhj0JbMhO2ka1-KImdiA-JrzlSYA0HaA3n47tBj1051kkSDsoWjWG_h8%3D)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b2abcf803a8e4fbfa0ac81867f655c45&_e=eiGQwHBUDJTV74lZBCbYKgNNDfAX9PNQNXEM2xZhSGjZjPBj0W8AJ-c_yQA4uYsXdbQtcxF6wSZPD-4wJaSlvd9ITy7GnosDNXT7U5eDy2ytviXmzgV8W3cCjMf3Z3XxN-Yn3SamfPvDcgjNA0RR-0XSlp9efXebz9Hd-ELGY1oOmvHhaTlToYsEgaqoomuCeYbGaFx22xgAsFxgRCB6UB-BaJjx4PzVmNGKQ6p8c3JLDRbIiminHYsxCoH_8iQuXkmGXHlmtwzWcurMAfKJfg47IzFRzu7pjMXZebpgfZEfaTOxKsCXq58Q9xmZohO8XWU1usp6OnBU0sptxM6TdH9RpXmVMwG2SmL4aytEtgSc96QAcyKkTJTlfm6uCNJz_e5Wcqk7h62FLcdkWtleyM4YCllLE_2X4NlvtW1BYiQFtsjg-JrzuoDM56GQs_lhdWl8jvqsxj1z8KG06lO9UrNarGiGibKOBnjMPCM8ys0%3D)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_.

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b2abcf803a8e4fbfa0ac81867f655c45&_e=eiGQwHBUDJTV74lZBCbYKgNNDfAX9PNQNXEM2xZhSGjZjPBj0W8AJ-c_yQA4uYsXdbQtcxF6wSZPD-4wJaSlvd9ITy7GnosDNXT7U5eDy2ytviXmzgV8W3cCjMf3Z3XxN-Yn3SamfPvDcgjNA0RR-0XSlp9efXebz9Hd-ELGY1oOmvHhaTlToYsEgaqoomuCeYbGaFx22xgAsFxgRCB6UB-BaJjx4PzVmNGKQ6p8c3JLDRbIiminHYsxCoH_8iQuRnpPgHYY1-SgTshfUQ-4CWr_KaDexsLNlN7vz6i_OAdcF1ADLwIlLXZx_plTKDFxamYuU0wko7iCPH5KnxEyWQUOUB0PruVoX29TANVL5AmMu_o0WiOwJBjngRL_Lm8O9xjQ8vCKg3_uSEqilMmXT1vOTLQcLfTWB8uuIoU8rb4AdRQpC-Q-3TcmVzamTv_QmZ6iJFEZ24zvbxriNNe_D9Clahk9SP7PtmnsWItvKgs%3D)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b2abcf803a8e4fbfa0ac81867f655c45&_e=eiGQwHBUDJTV74lZBCbYKgNNDfAX9PNQNXEM2xZhSGjZjPBj0W8AJ-c_yQA4uYsXdbQtcxF6wSZPD-4wJaSlvd9ITy7GnosDNXT7U5eDy2ytviXmzgV8W3cCjMf3Z3XxN-Yn3SamfPvDcgjNA0RR-0XSlp9efXebz9Hd-ELGY1oOmvHhaTlToYsEgaqoomuCeYbGaFx22xgAsFxgRCB6UB-BaJjx4PzVmNGKQ6p8c3JLDRbIiminHYsxCoH_8iQuHQ2CYawDxJUmFxXYS7QErdXdNEMmL88RVgZRnLeDM-SRLUdh1jn9Z9yVuyazxTm5SsfTroo9cfPjWxT9QK6WQn2jiZA3PaCb4lqGKG7TCVQXXDhW0un7HndATyxeCwJiwq0yAJSC1DIdJa85DHp72gm6KJyD60nrqgGOgCU1UeTuhpYallFeLnHGYYjBwHzvrW9EqPFkZ-bXJVLK4jqQHbVKlvAX1JoeU_o6NMmozqE%3D) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,

Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zveeqp3nuti5htajbmsmcn7kvgsasepl2nu547ko_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z2mn530bordjj2aaru2ld4jph9lfldtfe3s2jhig_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zc93vngjs05ld78uovjs7sbeq6n0358gnh6t3vro_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate – they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know – like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zd9n56f7t4th9i4mcrbu28gorgra2c95ve5tlk08_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ztqd378e2le6gquh6k3da6uh568d5tl5cvamqiso_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs) As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming – and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zsp5t8l5bb7gee63jhici99d7v4jnvbhum72ter0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zmno07n2jesepe01e2dmo0lk5o52vafd6uo30mao_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs) You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something – this will be the most important race in the entire country – but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zlh32i4382a3iels57eqqelbepugp1tt970bkpn0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zkiroarh74knr0grmp6c8g38g0dhelteh5udf23g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs) Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z95j4k273p8slj6mu0ptkgocf9lop0uurh4qdsfg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more – will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zd4eepbhv7run0t6liqvacavdicmfo3ok4rumqho_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs) [DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zte9v3jafcn2igb3mtsedqi401dbvmk39jvp8g6o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm4o33chh2bs)

subject: BLM vs Blexit
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zoam25a1fj0kgnrikettvdo0nfedoupgao13tbs0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ei3bd9ieir38cth6kpjactmekpradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8shi6jgn0s30ehhrbcj6cjhjep31meoj0t3gcgrbctble9o7ctr4coon7ddic1jt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8omcs9n6moefchicoob1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn48d245p25oh4cdim9or1chgm4p324no)
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znq17u3tad602rrqms3iotj9q1e47lgfr16hacpo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zub1n49cg7pgr7j1lpsh66f5ap22te37hpko4n3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zg21ku3d9v4tjq4jr7848durusdp3a6270efahr0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6hbm6jf55us4sre71qrrj33e4bakb0cq9dsm81o_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjt94ufdga7v16jj98cdj7rtud9adcf6g3bbucbo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z61vd8u7taaunq9d1muc6g2bhpcer2fbaio2o9e0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhgpduq3etnbl34q3bbqd0s42bgfb0vo068kv2qo_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zff300s7kljsk28lbh3sh89bd87mg15rqdirqs8g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zabnkkpopss1iq0rjg9jr9l4v8tgoeho1m1uoc40_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmh1u98tig9j1jl2iq51vnm1tstolfqpm8h3668g_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmfnski9s1dptd785q6i3ifeirvfhujth92n65ro_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhve5cpelicr9obv96stmbpce6io82skjh8sujjg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zkteniktqtdefqq7ngvi2g3qqfo2lcs9ku2jft10_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z90eupatv0546ri7e6bi2ae46vqi6voo68qhhv18_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmd504u8fh8bcc0u9j5ttvkrgudren8o4htj5ngg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zue9rqfplkgtunbmf43h41ssj306238vl5q1ha60_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zg4tp9nvpqr17h57suk4oo6bctgc2jmsbvj4enq0_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z94lf5eiq18fkjm6ntq29csgi98ghij76di5o6hg_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zun5p85mmsbdphh10let018qrfvb2qe3qnj36298_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4odv82f4tqjlfcergmanukbnudb86rdvlprniao_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3aeuhk1reophogm5s2od79m38151da026n0hjg8_rp22sh2s8i66pb4sdgm8ob2chh2bs)

People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?"

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_" If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor." \- Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation

ICYMI, it's official: Paul Junge is Dan’s opponent in the general election.

Here’s three things every mid-Michigan voter should know before casting their ballot:
* **_Paul Junge is not from here, having spent 43 years outside of Michigan._** He grew up in San Diego—having graduated high school, college and law school in California. He’s lived outside of Michigan for over four decades, struggling to hold down a job in seven states and renting an apartment in Grand Blanc to run for Congress.

* **_Paul Junge is using his million-dollar trust fund to try and buy a seat in Congress._** He has already contributed over $1 million of his own money to try and buy this congressional seat, despite not owning a home in mid-Michigan. He’s a multi-millionaire living off his family’s trust fund, who is out of touch with the needs of working families.

He would team up Republicans in Congress to cut funding for Social Security and Medicare, while raising taxes on the middle class. And unlike Dan Kildee who is taking on price gouging at the gas pump, Paul Junge would side with Big Oil companies, because he owns over $100,000 in ExxonMobil stock and he himself gets richer as they report record profits.

Team Kildee is ready to get to work but we need you to help fund it. = = Here’s Danya’s Original Message About What’s at Stake in this Election: ICYMI, it's official: Paul Junge is Dan’s opponent in the general election. Here’s three things every mid-Michigan voter should know before casting their ballot: Paul Junge is not from here, having spent 43 years outside of Michigan. He grew up in San Diego—having graduated high school, college and law school in California. He’s lived outside of Michigan for over four decades, struggling to hold down a job in seven states and renting an apartment in Grand Blanc to run for Congress. Paul Junge is using his million-dollar trust fund to try and buy a seat in Congress. He has already contributed over $1 million of his own money to try and buy this congressional seat, despite not owning a home in mid-Michigan. He’s a multi-millionaire living off his family’s trust fund, who is out of touch with the needs of working families. Paul Junge is too extreme for mid-Michigan. He supports a total abortion ban—with no exceptions for rape and incest. He would team up Republicans in Congress to cut funding for Social Security and Medicare, while raising taxes on the middle class. And unlike Dan Kildee who is taking on price gouging at the gas pump, Paul Junge would side with Big Oil companies, because he owns over $100,000 in ExxonMobil stock and he himself gets richer as they report record profits. body:
Turns out people would like to hold onto their freedoms
| Hey there,

On Tuesday, Kansas was the first state in the nation to hold a referendum on the recent Supreme Court ruling. Even in Kansas, a reliably-Republican state, voters overwhelmingly voted against an anti-abortion measure.

**Ohio has the opportunity to vote out a bunch of anti-choice Republicans this fall, and we need to make sure to have a high voter turnout to ensure we can hold onto our freedoms.**

Since _Roe_ was overturned, Ohio Republicans like Attorney General Yost and Governor DeWine have implemented and championed some of the most extreme anti-abortion laws in the country. DeWine even said he wants to "go as far as we can" to prohibit abortion.

Polling reveals that Ohioans want legal access to abortion services, yet Ohio Republicans like DeWine, Yost, and JD Vance want to take us backward. But anti-abortion measures are not only unpopular – they're dangerous.

Every pregnancy has the potential to be life-threatening, and laws like Ohio’s six-week abortion ban intrude on decisions that should be left to individuals and their physicians. Like Kansas, we can show up for and protect one another by standing together and remaining resilient in the face of injustice.

| My team and I wanted to share some important dates with you about the upcoming Democratic primary election (we understand how confusing this year has been!):

_In-Person Voting_
* **Saturday, August 13th - Sunday, August 21st:** Early voting period

* **Tuesday, August 23rd:** Primary Election Day! Polls are open from 6am to 9pm.

_Absentee Voting_
* **Monday, August 8th** : Absentee ballot request by mail or online is due (though you can request absentee ballots in person until August 22nd)

* **Tuesday, August 23rd:** Absentee ballot must be returned in person or be postmarked by this date (and, if mailed, received by August 30th)

Check out your county’s Board of Election website for more information.

As the only candidate in this race who was born and raised in our district, who went to public school here, and who voted in the district prior to running, I am committed to fighting for us and would be grateful for your support.

Thank you so much,

Matt Putorti

Peter,

Every morning I wake up, determined to get the most out of each day. I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one.

But I've got to tell you, MSNBC and their cast of far-Left characters do their best to ruin my day as often as they can. You might recall that earlier this year one of their regular panelists began attacking our Senate campaign.

In April, he called me an **"ignorant neophyte,"** and said that my candidacy is **"a white insult to Black people."**

Then he called Senator Tim Scott and me _**"tokens"**_ who are _**"shucking and jiving for their white handlers."** _

Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week:

| _**"Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their negroes: to do what they're told."**_
---

I'll repeat what I said in April: **this is racist, disgusting, and sad.**

What's also disturbing is that our opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. _Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so._

clean_body: I’ll repeat what I said before: this is racist, disgusting, and sad. | Peter, Every morning I wake up, determined to get the most out of each day. I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one. But I've got to tell you, MSNBC and their cast of far-Left characters do their best to ruin my day as often as they can. You might recall that earlier this year one of their regular panelists began attacking our Senate campaign. In April, he called me an "ignorant neophyte," and said that my candidacy is "a white insult to Black people." Then he called Senator Tim Scott and me "tokens" who are "shucking and jiving for their white handlers." Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week: | "Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their negroes: to do what they're told." I'll repeat what I said in April: this is racist, disgusting, and sad. What's also disturbing is that our opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so. Senator Warnock's silence is deafening and disappointing. The loudest and clearest way to push back against these kinds of disgusting attacks is to defeat them at the ballot box. Enough is enough. It's time to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. Thanks, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. name: Reagan Dunn
subject: My sincere thanks
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Reagan Dunn for
body:
I just called Matt Larkin to congratulate him on his primary
victory. Matt ran an honorable and positive campaign, and I am
proud to endorse him in this November's election. Matt will make
a wonderful Congressman and I encourage all of my supporters to
support him as well.

Friends,

I just called Matt Larkin to
congratulate him on his primary victory. Matt ran an honorable
and positive campaign, and I am proud to endorse him in this
November's election. Matt will make a wonderful Congressman and I
encourage all of my supporters to support him as well.

I am proud of the campaign we
ran, and I look forward to continuing to serve this area on the
King County Council. I will keep fighting for the values I ran
on, supporting our law enforcement heroes and ensuring fiscal
responsibility. I will continue in my commitment to be a voice of
reason on the County Council, and push back against extreme and
irresponsible policies. Now more than ever, we need local leaders
in King County who will stand up for what's right, not what's
politically expedient.

Most importantly, I want to say
thank you. Thank you to all of my supporters for volunteering
your time, donations, and energy to helping me in this endeavor.
You gave me the courage to keep pressing forward when times got
tough.

And of course, I want to thank my
wife and amazing children for the patience and love they showed
throughout this process. I am eternally grateful to have had them
by my side on this campaign. There is no greater job I could ever
have than that of being a father to my beautiful children.

Once again, thank you to all of
you for going with me on this amazing journey. It has been an
honor.

Yours truly,

Reagan Dunn

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If we got your name or any
information wrong, we apologize. To update and correct your
information, click here. If you would like to unsubscribe, click
here.

Thank you for supporting Reagan
Dunn's campaign for Congress.
Paid for by Reagan Dunn for
Congress

body:
#

Earlier this week, abortion rights were on the ballot in Kansas, and the answer from voters was resoundingly in favor of the right to abortion. Nearly 60 percent of voters in Kansas voted in favor of keeping their state constitution’s protections for abortion.
For years, pundits in Washington told us abortion rights were not a winning issue at the ballot box. It’s a big reason why reproductive freedom was never a priority in Congress, and now today, abortion has been completed or nearly banned in dozens of states.
Republicans like our opponent Ted Budd got exactly what they wanted when the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , and next they want to pass a national abortion ban without exceptions.
The contrast could not be clearer: Elect Cheri Beasley and secure the decisive 51st vote to protect abortion rights once and for all, or elect Ted Budd and give Republicans another vote for a national abortion ban in the Senate.
It’s up to us to make sure we have the resources to make the stakes in November clear to voters. If we do that, we win and expand our majority. But we need your help:
[**Can you please make a $3 donation to ensure Cheri has the resources to reach every single voter necessary to win in November? It’s important that every voter knows exactly what’s on the line in North Carolina.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220804-1-ma&t=1&akid=1381%2E357359%2E_ueDRs)

The pundits who spent years questioning whether abortion rights were a winning issue electorally are the same ones who are trying to say that Democrats have no chance this fall. They say history is against us, and there’s nothing we can do.
That’s utter nonsense, and we know it. The Republicans’ agenda is more extreme than ever, and their politicized Supreme Court is threatening so many of our fundamental rights and freedoms.
We absolutely can win. So let’s go prove them wrong and defy history with Cheri Beasley.

| Farm Bureau Endorses Dahle for Governor

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE, August 4, 2022
CONTACT: Josh Cook

SACRAMENTO --- The California Farm Bureau, representing agricultural producers in nearly every county in California, has endorsed Senator Brian Dahle in his race to become the next Governor of California, applauding his commitment to protecting and supporting California’s largest industry.

“Thanks to its amazing natural features, California from the earliest days of statehood has been an agricultural wonderland, and we’re still the top farm state in the nation,” Dahle said. “Unfortunately, the state has stopped supporting its farms. Our crops compete on a global market, but only-in-California laws drive up labor and fuel costs, restrict the use of critical farm inputs, and limit water availability.

“As governor, I will support the people who feed the world with healthy, California-grown crops, from the avocados of San Diego County to the organic alfalfa of Modoc County.”

The California Farm Bureau applauds Senator Dahle’s work as a true citizen-legislator who continues to operate his family’s farm and seed business in Lassen County while serving in the state Legislature and his strong support of meeting the state’s commitments to build new water storage and otherwise improve vital water supplies.

“As a State Senator who returns to his farm every week, Brian Dahle understands the consequences legislation and regulations are having on family farms", said Farm Bureau President Jamie Johansson. "As a third-generation Californian, Dahle knows how our disturbing new normal of scarcity—including a lack of water, and shortages of electricity, fuel, food and housing—has brought many California families and businesses to the breaking point. California Farm Bureau supports Brian’s urgent fight to restore our state and provide opportunities for all Californians.”

Senator Brian Dahle represents 1 million constituents in northeastern California in the state Legislature, where he has served since winning the election in 2012.
