name: Bernie Sanders
subject: I have officially endorsed Jamaal Bowman for Congress
body:
Today I’m reaching out to you to share my most recent endorsement of Jamaal and tell you why it’s absolutely crucial that we do everything we can to ensure that he is reelected to keep fighting for our communities.
#
Hi Peter, it's Bernie Sanders.
Today I’m reaching out to you to share my most recent endorsement of Jamaal and tell you why it’s absolutely crucial that we do everything we can to ensure that he is reelected to keep fighting for our communities.
But before I go any further, I need to ask you one question. [Can I count on you to show up for Jamaal and our progressive movement by splitting whatever amount you can give towards his re-election campaign and Justice Democrats? Early voting starts in just 9 days, so we need to buckle down and do everything in our power to make sure Jamaal has the tools and resources to win this race. ](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113295?refcode=em20220804-24576&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=24576%2E1203867%2ERRIyfV)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113295?refcode=em20220804-24576&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=24576%2E1203867%2ERRIyfV)**
I am so proud to endorse Jamaal for re-election. Now more than ever, we need more progressive champions in Congress, like Jamaal, who don’t take corporate PAC money and are committed to ensuring that the large, profitable corporations that have been ripping off working families are held accountable.
But as we speak, there are establishment and corporate special interests who are sharpening their knives and strengthening their resources to halt our progressive vision. They’re funneling hundreds of thousands of dollars into the pockets of Jamaal’s conservative opponents to ensure that Jamaal is a one-term Congressperson.
**Jamaal has been a critical partner in this fight for working people long before he joined our progressive movement in Congress.** We’ve worked together on many fronts to build up a multi-racial, multi-class democracy that truly works for us all. From holding the disgraceful representatives and actors who took part in our nation's horrific insurrection attempt on January 6th, to standing up to the greed of pandemic profiteers with the Ending Corporate Greed Act — I look forward to continuing our work together.
Whatsmore, Jamaal’s experience as an educator brings both compassion and understanding to our politics when both are in extremely short supply. We need voices in Congress, like Jamaal’s, who have a lifetime of experience advocating for children and the most vulnerable so no one is left behind.
Peter, we need to come together to send a message loud and clear that our progressive power isn’t going anywhere soon. Each day is a new day to recommit ourselves to the fight to end systemic injustice and inequality in our country and continue passing key policies that will truly benefit us all.
[ If you stand with us, please split $3 or anything you are able to ensure that Jamaal can win against his opponents and continue fighting for our progressive vision in Congress by supporting Justice Democrats. Please chip in today.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/113295?refcode=em20220804-24576&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=24576%2E1203867%2ERRIyfV)
Thank you for all that you have done, Peter.
Bernie Sanders

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=22&akid=24576%2E1203867%2ERRIyfV) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=23&akid=24576%2E1203867%2ERRIyfV) and your state public health department.
---

subject: What comes after Kansas' vote on abortion
body:
Derek,
As governor of Kansas, I've always maintained that reproductive health care decisions should be between a person and their doctor.
But on August 2nd, extremists tried to force their will on all of us by attempting to amend our constitution. I'm proud to say that Kansans stood up for our fundamental rights and rejected government overreach. But our work isn't done.
The dark money groups who tried to buy the August 2nd vote are now refocusing their efforts on my election. As the most vulnerable governor on the ballot this year, I'm asking for your help to make sure they can't take us back in time.
Will you chip in to make sure CommonGood and I have the resources to fight back? Help us continue defending your rights across the country and Kansas by splitting a donation to our campaigns now. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_kelly?refcode=20220804_CGVA_Laura_Kelly]
Before I took office, Kansas was deep in debt, schools were drastically underfunded, and families were struggling, all thanks to a series of extreme ideological decisions of my predecessor.
Voters put me in charge of fixing those mistakes, and since then, we've fully funded our schools, added and retained tens of thousands of jobs, and built a record budget surplus. But just like in many states across the country, the politicians who drove my state into the ditch are now trying to take the keys back.
My opponent has a massive cash-on-hand advantage and dark money groups are pouring millions of dollars into my state to reboot their economic experiment. If we don't raise the funds to fight back, they'll push the same extreme policies in every state they can, including yours.
Derek, help me build on the victory we won on August 2nd. Can you split a $25 donation between my campaign and CommonGood so we can continue defending your rights and our future. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_kelly?refcode=20220804_CGVA_Laura_Kelly]

Hi team,

As a member of our team, you know that I think the best way to restore faith in our democracy is for government to deliver policies that improve people’s lives. And there’s nothing I enjoy more than hearing from my constituents about the challenges they’re facing and discussing what can actually be done.

Inflation is a problem. So I’ve said: let’s pass the CHIPS Act, and fix our supply chains by bringing manufacturing of key technologies back to America. Lower the cost of prescription drugs, and extend health insurance subsidies. Get refineries back up and running to increase gas supplies, while lowering demand for fossil fuels by helping more Americans afford electric vehicles.

**[But here’s the thing. Even though my opponent’s campaign says this election will be about what’s wrong with the economy, don’t expect to see him talking about his proposed solutions. Team, I can say with confidence that Tom Kean Jr. is NEVER going to stand on a stage and face real voters and answer a single question how to create jobs, lower costs, or make America more competitive — because in 20 years as an elected official, he’s never held a single town hall or public meeting with his constituents.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48796241/359612693/1719613603?amount=10&refcode=TM_EM_FR_3MO_20220804_1_1&refcode2=cdef2329-4014-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZGVmMjMyOS00MDE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tgXdNo-2cft5YQ6Fui4bZBC1bhwCe2BaMy0J0COGMP4=)**

| | Dear friend, After hearing the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade,_ the very first thing I did — maybe like some of you — was call my mom. My mom taught me from a young age that my voice _matters_. She raised me to stand up and speak out when I witnessed injustice around me, and she raised me to fight not with anger, but with love. And in a moment of overwhelming fear and anger and sadness, her words brought me strength. I know that, like me, many of you are looking to my mom for our next steps in the coming months. **That fills me with hope for our future, because there is _no_ better leader in this fight than Patty Pansing Brooks.** My mom has stood on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature late into the night battling horrible bans on our reproductive health care. She has worked directly alongside Planned Parenthood to keep safe, legal abortion in Nebraska. And my mom has made a promise to our district that she will continue fighting with _everything_ she has to protect our reproductive rights. **Friend, if you know my mom, you know she’s _never_ broken a promise.** Our current congressman has already voted to **strip our bodily autonomy** and **restrict our access to necessary health care like birth control.** But this November, our district has the opportunity to fight back by electing a leader who has advocated at the frontlines for our reproductive rights since the beginning of her career. **[If you agree that abortion and birth control are necessary health care we cannot afford to lose, please chip in today so my mom can continue her fight in Congress:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48789283/359581475/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220803_fromavary&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220803_fromavary&refcode2=2e953556-2114-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTk1MzU1Ni0yMTE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2yE2dYcUzxHTPlfUQqQm2J2UmAc4v5sCJo9bNSc_2Gc=)** _If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your contribution will be processed instantly._ | | [**DONATE $10**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48789285/359581477/333259033?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=em_220803_fromavary&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220803_fromavary&refcode2=2e953556-2114-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZTk1MzU1Ni0yMTE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2yE2dYcUzxHTPlfUQqQm2J2UmAc4v5sCJo9bNSc_2Gc=)

And in a moment of overwhelming fear and anger and sadness, her words brought me strength. I know that, like me, many of you are looking to my mom for our next steps in the coming months. # Friends of Cavaleri for Congress,

## Our race for Washington’s First Congressional District has been called by virtually every news outlet. Mathematically, the other candidates cannot catch up to our vote count with the remaining votes still left to be counted. We achieved exactly what we set out to do; and that’s to finish in the top two. Simply put, we are going to the November ballot thanks to all of you.

Now the real work begins as we carry out the last phase of the campaign strategy.

We will be making some team additions and shuffling some folks around, as we prepare for the final push, starting Friday, August 5. I’m excited about the next 90 days as we sprint to the finish line. We have executed our plan flawlessly thus far, and I’m confident we will be victorious this November.

We could not have done this without all of you. Winning the August primary was huge, but only the first step. As we march into the final stretch, I’m calling on all of you to stand with me as we defend our republic from tyranny. The same people that shuttered your businesses, destroyed your careers, defunded your police, locked your children out of school and decimated our economy want you to re-elect them. _We simply can't afford them anymore_.

We will need to be steadfast and deliberate in our efforts, remembering that our opponent in this race is worth roughly 100 million dollars and will spend every penny to stay in office; just as she has done in years past. Your role as supporters will be vital to our success.

In closing, I wanted to reiterate my heartfelt gratitude to all of you. We are in this position because of all of you. The next step is to take this across the finish line together and return America back to “We the People.”

## Blessings to you always,

Hey team – I’ll be brief. I want to give you an idea of why the NDRC needs to be in the fight for fair redistricting for the long haul.

First, because _Republicans keep trying to rig the maps,_ lawsuits are ongoing. We can expect them in places like Ohio, Louisiana, Florida, Georgia, and Texas (those states have a whopping 101 U.S. House seats between them!).

Second, some maps will need to be redrawn after the 2022 elections. So we need to invest in new technologies, data, and mapping innovations.

Third, our movement has helped pass redistricting reforms that secured fair maps in states like Colorado and Michigan – _but it’s not enough._ We have to be able to build on those successes to achieve powerful reforms in even more states.

(That’s not even mentioning our work to keep the GOP from completely undermining American democracy!)

subject: I just looked at the clock, friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Val Demings for U
body:
My mind is on my parents in these final 96 days of the election.
| | |
---
Hi friend,

I'm not sure when my team will get this note to your inbox, but I have a few minutes to spare right now – so I wanted to talk to you about the final 96 days of this campaign, starting with a quick story from when I was a little girl.
My parents, James and Elouise, weren't rich. My father worked as a janitor. My mother was a maid. Neither finished high school. But they had such a profound sense of duty to make life _better_ for me and my six brothers and sisters. They grounded the importance of education and civic responsibility into us.

As a matter of fact, my parents took their civic responsibility so seriously that they were 100% faithful to voting. Every time. In one instance, when our station wagon wouldn't start, they paid someone to drive them to the polls.

**They were so committed to voting, friend, that as a little girl, I thought it was illegal _not_ to vote!**
My mind is on my parents in these final 96 days of the election. People just like James and Elouise Butler – people who count so much on our democracy – are already casting their ballots in Florida's primary. They'll likely be thinking of their families as they tick off a box, hoping the people they send to Washington will do right by them and _commit to bettering _the lives of those they serve.
I know this because as I travel across Florida and meet so many incredible people, I hear stories that remind me of my upbringing. I hear stories that inspire me every day to _win this race_ so we can do better for Floridians and all of America. **So take this to heart straight from me, friend: I am in this race to win, and when I make it to the U.S. Senate, we’ll be able to pass a bold legislative agenda.**
My time is up, and I need to get on with my day. Before I sign off though, I've got to ask: **With polling showing me neck and neck with Marco Rubio, can you chip in a grassroots donation of $5 or whatever you can spare to help me pull ahead, win and expand our Democratic Senate majority? Enjoy the rest of your day, friend – and thanks for everything you do for this grassroots campaign.

This week, voters in Kansas overwhelmingly voted to protect abortion access.

Kansas! A red state that Trump won by 15%.

Today, I’m more motivated than ever to protect reproductive rights here in Florida.

These results show that voters, regardless of party or background, overwhelmingly support access to abortion.

So what are Democrats waiting for? It’s time to protect abortion rights at the federal level – and bypass the filibuster if necessary! Click here to add your name if you agree. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/x7l4iYvUc0CNvhzenMjYwA2]

I’m tired of the excuses. There’s no reason we can’t pass legislation to protect abortion rights nationwide.

From Kansas to Florida, Americans are on the same page. Let’s get this done.

–Jared

That’s why I’m working so hard to pass the _Inflation Reduction Act_ to help cut down the costs you’re paying every day and take once-in-a-generation action to address the climate crisis at the same time. body:
This week, we were handed a road map to victory in our own campaign. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xQsZ_uHW9ME9h2VPudEgVBlT0rAEcoX_uBPlqDgEOfEQIhz_Vu9SFmd68KrwuQ3aJegxlzx0WErTIW4hjJyWkR3J90f6KLMbnzRCJwbZ8APoNXc1Fnu1bI6YqEmlCS0-baak25VpQXIbj1YICe27tOHo772UpTReXG12W9xVbTua5dqHHmZXnhDd3WAQ7JQIBY6a_gPsAqif7mXupGBH-agTHVdcbqUulFe2Zk8ccZqjtxAgVvMKIy9vxX3LWwlJUZ5NVVuFM_QyoMYIWPJ6PTaBgLQmCRqBc_w9UoCyQAHIb69vPaYrvA0bH-kS4sMTuZCzOeh6Ahu1-XCzl7iB9TC00kux9U3iMlOtfOrGBD-8eFVXSRsfOmtxS2DMfbq9w/3ob/WLdtJ7XdR4CQSPKDe1_yHA/h0/XPURVLxq7yydelLCU9SQPVbG67aX6NEixyAoSQXgkuU) Hey Peter, Sometimes I get asked why we think we can win this race in a “red district” in Tennessee. This week, we got a road map — a massive victory in Kansas, where voters soundly defeated an amendment that would’ve opened the door to an abortion ban, 59% to 41%. Voters turned out in record numbers to defend their reproductive freedom from extremist Republicans determined to take their rights away. Peter, that’s an 18% victory for abortion rights in a state that’s supposed to be +10 for Republicans — an almost 30% swing. **You know where else is supposed to be comfortable for Republicans? body:
Reproductive rights won in Kansas. Next up, Michigan.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220804-3274-header&t=1&akid=3274%2E2526796%2EyfbMbp)
Voters in Kansas just sent an _undeniable_ message that abortion rights are not up for debate.
In the first electoral test of abortion rights since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , Kansans turned out _**in record numbers**_ to reject a constitutional amendment that would have would have opened the door for lawmakers to further restrict or ban abortions across the state.1
**This vote proves that there is widespread support for reproductive freedom from red to blue states. Now we must keep up this momentum.**
Activists in Michigan are leading an effort to protect reproductive freedom in the state’s constitution through a ballot initiative this November – and they need our help to organize and turn out voters.
[If you’re able to, will you pitch in $3 to the Michigan Reproductive Freedom for All fund to support their efforts to protect reproductive freedom?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220804.z9b41j&refcode=em20220804-3274-P_FND_CHA_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3274%2E2526796%2EyfbMbp)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220804.z9b41j&refcode=em20220804-3274-P_FND_CHA_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3274%2E2526796%2EyfbMbp)**
_100% of your donation will support this growing coalition of Michigan advocates including ACLU of Michigan, Michigan Voices, Planned Parenthood Advocates of Michigan, and more._
[If you’d like to volunteer with Reproductive Freedom for All, please sign up here.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14809?source=aoc-em20220804-3274&utm_source=aoc-em20220804-3274&t=22&akid=3274%2E2526796%2EyfbMbp)
With your support, we can help pass this ballot measure in November and secure reproductive freedom for millions of people. In addition, we can send an unmistakable message that voters across the political spectrum will not stand on the sidelines when it comes to decisions about their own bodies.
Thank you (as always) for stepping up to support in these key moments.
Let’s win this.
– Team AOC

Hello,

For over four decades I've sought to truly understand and appreciate America's promise by telling its stories. Through my work I have found that the story of this great country is often best told through its inflection points.
And folks, this year's election is one such inflection point.
Our history shows us that at moments like these we must come together to support the leaders who will fight to secure our future – leaders like Senator Maggie Hassan.
Our country stands at a crossroads that demands we respond with all the civil energies at our disposal. As we rise up to meet this moment, Americans must stand against the scourge of extremism that a Republican Senate majority would usher in. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the Democratic majority is too fragile to allow the GOP to flip even one seat — and New Hampshire is too purple a state to leave to chance.
That's why I'm reaching out today **[to ask you to contribute whatever you can to our efforts to secure Democrat Maggie Hassan's bid for reelection.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48799551/359623922/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1420-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NjFhYmRkYy00OTE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MEhv49WLx_2Lqnl2x9iaX03_CxJp5iE9iMXvS6sSmVY=)** With only four months until Election Day we must act decisively to help Senator Hassan defend New Hampshire's Senate seat.
As a longtime New Hampshire resident, I've followed Maggie's stellar career serving the people of the Granite State. I have deep faith in her drive and ability to meet the challenges that we're facing right now.
Maggie's singular voice is one that we just can't afford to lose in the Senate. **[Please join me in getting her campaign the resources they need to both stand up to every attack and to turn out every vote.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48799552/359623923/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1420-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NjFhYmRkYy00OTE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MEhv49WLx_2Lqnl2x9iaX03_CxJp5iE9iMXvS6sSmVY=)**
Maggie is facing an uphill battle, but I know she is up to the task; I only hope that we can rise up to meet her and grant her our full support. The stakes have never been higher.
Ken

clean_body: | | | Peter — When Republicans achieved their 40 year campaign to overturn Roe , they didn’t realize the fury they unleashed. But last Tuesday, they got their first taste. In a resounding victory for reproductive rights, voters in Kansas turned out in droves — with the highest turnout since 2008 — and defeated a constitutional amendment that would have removed protections for abortion rights in the state constitution by seventeen points. This wasn’t just a ripple, this was a tsunami. And we’re just getting started. Everywhere Republicans go, we intend to hold them accountable — and get them on record for their anti-abortion views. That’s why we’re launching Green Wave Wednesdays — where every Wednesday this month, voters will pay a visit to their representatives and ask them where they stand on abortion rights. Inspired by the Green Wave movement in Argentina, where thousands flooded the streets every week for years until the Green Wave grew into the force that won abortion rights, we’re not giving up until every woman and person seeking an abortion has regained full control of their reproductive rights. It starts with getting Republican lawmakers on record for their anti-abortion views. So we’re asking constituents to get them on record — so that when voters head to the polls this November — they’ll be ready to deliver a stunning rebuke for their attacks on our reproductive rights. Take your righteous fury and dive into action with us, Peter. In solidarity, Team WFP P.S. Want more ways to take action? **My name is Pat Ryan, and I’m running for Congress in the August special election to defend Lt. Governor Antonio Delgado’s seat.**

We’re at a defining moment in our history. While everyday families struggle to put food on the table, extremists are choosing to attack our fundamental values — everything from women’s reproductive rights to voting rights. We deserve better.

Since launching our campaign, we’ve raised more than double our opponent and built a winning campaign to hold this critical seat. Now, with just 19 days left, national Republicans are pouring in money to stop our movement and enact their extremist agenda.

I refuse to let that happen without a fight. That’s why I’m reaching out to you:

As a combat veteran, I have put my life on the line to defend our country’s foundational freedoms. Now as Ulster County Executive, I’ve helped steer my community through a once-in-a-century pandemic, provided direct financial relief to small businesses and residents, and re-invested in mental health services. And we did all of this while never raising taxes.

**This race is not going to be easy – especially in this final 19-day stretch.** Our upcoming special election will determine whether or not Democrats maintain this battleground seat and secure our House majority, meaning we need to step up.

I’m ready to bring New York values to Washington, but I’m counting on your support every step of the way.

[_**It’ll take all of us to fend off the GOP’s attacks and keep our seat blue. If you’re able, I hope you will split a donation between my campaign and Backroads PAC today.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48799756/359624672/-308739791?refcode=BLU-BRP-20220804-1-EM&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODM2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlOWJkZmFhZS00YjE0LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ylm2nVi_5IT-d0r3eZstYCO5wIkXcxlN2JKtqzbi2Oc=)

Pat Ryan

| I couldn't let another day go by without mentioning the latest outrage from the GOP's obstruction in Congress.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=613%2E5257348%2EYR2d6B)
Derek, I couldn't let another day go by without mentioning the latest outrage from the GOP's obstruction in Congress.
Not only did Kevin McCarthy and House Republicans try to block a bill that would _grow_ US manufacturing, _create_ jobs, and _lower_ prices — their counterparts in the Senate blocked a bill to give health care to military veterans exposed to _toxic burn pits_ during their time in Iraq and Afghanistan.
You heard that right. Republicans blocked legislation to help veterans exposed to toxic burn pits. And it is absolutely **_maddening_**.
Republicans tell you that “big government” is your enemy, and then do everything in their power to make it so. They rig the courts and hide behind the filibuster while enforcing their extremist beliefs to control women’s bodies, endanger our children, and so much more.
They tell you they’re the “pro-military,” “pro-family” party, and then oppose legislation that would support veterans, make the expanded Child Tax Credit permanent, and attack LGBT youth. The list goes on, and on, and on.
They're against everything. For nothing. And that's why we can't let Republicans take power in either the House or Senate.

name: Charles Booker
subject: Accountability is long overdue
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Today, Attorney General Merrick Garland announced that the Justice
Department has charged four current and former Louisville Metro Police
Department officers with federal crimes related to the death of Breonna
Taylor.

While this is a step towards justice and accountability that is long
overdue, it doesn’t change the fact that remains: Breonna Taylor should be
alive right now.

What I want, and what people across Kentucky want, is true community
safety. We want a commonwealth where everyone, Black, White, or Brown, can
feel safe walking down our streets or sleeping in our beds. We want to
make sure this happens to no one else and so, our fight for justice
continues.

My heart remains with Breonna Taylor’s family, and the families of so many
others whose loved ones were murdered without any accountability.

We will never stop saying Breonna’s name.

In solidarity,

Charles Booker

Fellow American,

Every morning I wake up, determined to get the most out of each day. I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one.

But I've got to tell you, MSNBC and their cast of far-Left characters do their best to ruin my day as often as they can. You might recall that earlier this year one of their regular panelists began attacking our Senate campaign.

In April, he called me an **"ignorant neophyte,"** and said that my candidacy is **"a white insult to Black people."**

Then he called Senator Tim Scott and me _**"tokens"**_ who are _**"shucking and jiving for their white handlers."** _

Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week:

| _**"Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their negroes: to do what they're told."**_
---

I'll repeat what I said in April: **this is racist, disgusting, and sad.**

What's also disturbing is that our opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. _Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so._

_**Senator Warnock's silence is deafening and disappointing.**_

I'm an optimist and firmly believe it takes more effort to have a bad day than a good one. You might recall that earlier this year one of their regular panelists began attacking our Senate campaign. In April, he called me an "ignorant neophyte," and said that my candidacy is "a white insult to Black people." Then he called Senator Tim Scott and me "tokens" who are "shucking and jiving for their white handlers." Now, he's back at it again, saying this about me on MSNBC earlier this week: | "Walker is doing what he's told, and that is what Republicans like. That's what Republicans want from their negroes: to do what they're told." I'll repeat what I said in April: this is racist, disgusting, and sad. What's also disturbing is that our opponent, who also happens to be Black, has never once condemned any of these blatantly racist remarks. Can you imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat? The outrage would be instantaneous and overwhelming - and rightly so. Senator Warnock's silence is deafening and disappointing. The loudest and clearest way to push back against these kinds of disgusting attacks is to defeat them at the ballot box. Enough is enough. This race is unbelievably close, so we only have two choices: we either step up our own ad buys to push back, or risk being completely drowned out on the airwaves. = JD’s campaign is barely treading water, and we always knew national Republicans and billionaire-funded super PACs would try to buy this Senate seat with dark money and misleading ads. This brand new ad talks about how JD “will give back to Ohio.” 🙄 Give me a break. This guy BAILED on Ohio to make millions in Silicon Valley, so the idea of him “giving back” is both laughable and infuriating—Ohioans deserve better. If we get drowned out on the airwaves, we won’t be able to respond to JD’s lies and manipulations, and we’ve got to reach every single voter in the Buckeye State if we’re going to expand our Senate majority.= If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be immediately split between John Fetterman and Admiral Mike Franken's campaigns: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thanks, Tim Ryan Paid for by Michael Franken for Iowa, Inc Michael Franken for Iowa, Inc PO Box 13401 Des Moines, IA 50310 United States

subject: Weekly Newsletter: Welcome to August
body:
KeithPekau.com |
---
| | [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=d235d377bf&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

This week, I got quite a bit of interest in a Facebook post about a drug bust in Orland Park. The photo, posted below, is from a February 2022 case in which DEA Task Force Officers obtained information from an informant regarding a large amount of methamphetamine being transported through the area, related to the Sinaloa Cartel - a direct result of Biden’s border policies that Sean Casten supports. They coordinated a transaction through an undercover agent for February 14.2022. On this day, officers stopped this vehicle and recovered 48lbs of methamphetamine.

I was really pleased that so many people from all walks of life expressed their support for the great work of our law enforcement officers.

The reality is everyone wants to be kept safe. No one wants their kids or family exposed to the crime organizations and activities that bring Fentanyl and other drugs into our communities.

It’s only politicians who make support for law enforcement seem controversial. They put politics ahead of the people they are supposed to represent.
---
|
---
| Keeping our streets safe requires working with law enforcement at the local and federal levels. This is the approach we’ve taken in Orland Park. As a result, we’ve gotten drugs and criminals off the street.

My opponent, Sean Casten voted against a bipartisan measure to extend a federal ban on the illegal sale of fentanyl. Had the vote gone his way, it would have been substantially harder for federal law enforcement to prosecute drug dealers. Protecting criminals has become a calling card for politicians like Sean Casten and his party - whether they’re in Cook County or Congress.

The impact has been devastating. According to WBEZ, Cook County had a record number of fatal fentanyl overdoses in 2021. And the DuPage County Coroner's office has reported that deaths from drug overdoses continue to rise.

I’ve had enough of it. That’s why I am running. I brought common sense leadership to Orland Park and I am going to Congress to do the same, and I am so grateful to have your support in this effort!

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
_Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District_
---
|
---
| _**In Case You Missed It**_ Our team was out and about this talking with families in DuPage about bringing common sense leadership to Washington. I want to sincerely thank everyone who has been working so hard!

If you have some time to lend to the cause, join our team at: [KeithPekau.com/Volunteer](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=17c321be62&e=7dd0b93d07).
---
| [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=88bf7244a8&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| _**Pekau: 'Real leaders don't stand by while crime is on the rise and our kids are at risk'**_ Mayor Keith Pekau of Orland Park announced that Cook County will allocate $2.6 million to address the opioid epidemic. The problem of opioid addiction has become increasingly worse over the last few years.

_"Opioid overdoses in Cook County have spiked over the last few years," Pekau said. "From 2018 to 2020, there were 4,283 opioid-related deaths in Cook County with nearly 82 percent of those deaths from June 6 through December 23, 2020 showing the presence of fentanyl in their systems. In 2021, opioid-related deaths surpassed 1,900 cases, according to the Cook County Medical Examiner's Office. In Orland Park, our police department has been doing their part to curb this epidemic. We have seen drug-related arrests increase 25% over the past 5 years and implemented the Mobile Response Unit. Real leaders don’t stand by while crime is on the rise and our kids are at risk. I took it on as Mayor. I am going to Congress to do the same."_

[Read the full article in South Cook News here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=9b60e51e14&e=7dd0b93d07)
_**Pekau: ‘If we don't like the way things are tracking, then we change the rules’**_
Pekau, who is the mayor of Orland Park, noted inflation is not being properly tracked. He is running in Illinois’ 6th Congressional District.

_"This seems to be the standard playbook: If we don't like the way things are tracking, then we change the rules,”_ Pekau said on [Newsmax](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=98479164da&e=7dd0b93d07). _“Look at how we've changed the way inflation is tracked. We don't include gasoline or food prices, which is what hits people in the pocketbook the most. If you included those things, we'd have inflation at 17 or 18% right now. So at the end of the day, everyone on this call, as well as everyone that's watching knows what is happening in America, knows that we're facing a recession and that we've been seeing inflation that – essentially, at the rate it's at – takes one month of your pay."_

During his term as mayor, Pekau has doubled investments in the village's infrastructure while managing to reduce total operating costs by 14%, according to his website. Pekau also lowered property tax rates and paid down more than $50 million of the village's debt.

[Read the full article in South Cook News here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=7a892bfe3d&e=7dd0b93d07)**[](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=b04b91af04&e=7dd0b93d07)**
---
|
---
|
# **_Connecting the Dots_**
---
|
# **$522 More**

[The Illinois Policy Institute](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=498f705b05&e=7dd0b93d07) found that Illinoisans are paying $522 more for the same grocery items bought last year due to inflation.
---
|
---
| **From Keith: **_Sean Casten called inflation "a good thing," and has voted with Nancy Pelosi and Joe Biden to raise costs on families. Does he really represent us? I don't think so.

He doesn’t get it. Last year, Rep. Sean Casten [told voters ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=cba0f251d9&e=7dd0b93d07)" the inflation we are seeing in the economy right now is passing, transitory, and manageable." Got it? Settle down. Don’t believe your eyes. Nevermind your household finances. Sean Casten says this is “manageable.”

Unlike Rep Casten, I wasn’t born with a silver-spoon in my mouth. Nor have I spent half my adult life in Washington DC. I feel the pain most families are feeling thanks to the failed policies of Joe Biden and Sean Casten. I am going to Congress to restore common sense and protect you from scams that Sean Casten out of touch DC bureaucrats are running on your life._
---
|
---

---

_10700 W 153rd St, Orland Park, IL_

---
| **_Get Involved_**
---
| Politicians in Washington, DC like Sean Casten, and Nancy Pelosi have put special interests, party politics, and extreme agendas ahead of doing what’s best for the people they’re supposed to represent.

Keith Pekau is the common sense, local leader we need in Washington to take on the extreme politicians. His record of results stands in stark contrast to the failed, divisive politics and rigid ideology of Sean Casten.

Whether you choose to contribute, knock on doors, or host a yard sign on your front lawn, every little bit counts and helps my campaign inch closer to victory.

[**Click here to get started!**](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=41a5ca678f&e=7dd0b93d07)

| Friend-- It's hard to believe, but the election is fewer than 100 days out. | | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: >From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Team,

For the past few months, the January 6 Committee has been exposing the lies, crimes, and hypocrisy of Donald Trump and his Treason Caucus friends. **With the next set of hearings set to take place in September, we wanted to #ThrowBackThursday to some important (and disgusting) highlights from the hearings:**

**June 9**

The first hearing looked at the **absolute devastation on the United States Capitol when the insurrectionists breached it on January 6.** A 10-minute video of previously unseen footage showed a heartbreaking interview in which a Capitol police officer recalled the violence she saw and had to fight that day.

**June 13**

In the next hearing, the Committee focused on the **#BigLie and revealed evidence that Trump and his advisors knew from the VERY BEGINNING** that election fraud had not taken place.

**June 16**

The focus of the third hearing was the extreme amount of **pressure Donald Trump placed on Mike Pence to overturn the election.** These intimidation tactics included verbal abuse, riling up the mob, and even a kidnapping scheme.

**June 21**

The hearing on June 21 on the other hand, focused on the **pressure the Trump administration placed on other elected officials to overturn the election.** Arizona officials and election workers provided testimony that they endured harassment and threats to their lives.

**June 23**

Another group that faced enormous pressure to support the #BigLie was our country's very own Department of Justice. Three former **officials spoke about the threats from Trump to declare the election as “tainted”** and appoint his own puppet to conduct a sham investigation.

**June 28**

In a bombshell testimony, former White House aide, **Cassidy Hutchinson testified about the horrifying things she witnessed during and leading up to the insurrection.** From revealing Trump's physical assault on a Secret Service agent to his ketchup-laced tantrums in the Oval Office – and even his support of the insurrectionists carrying weapons, she laid it all out on the table for the country to see.

**July 12**

On the first hearing of July, the Committee presented how Trump was responsible for the insurrection, and we heard testimony from former **Oathkeepers and Proudboys who led the "revolution."**

**July 21**

In the latest hearing, Donald Trump's inaction and attempts to further rile up the crowd were exposed. Trump Administration White House Council Pat Cipollone recounted how **Donald Trump ignored pleas from his administration and even his daughter to condemn the attack.** It was unveiled that after seeing the violence, Trump decided to further attack Mike Pence and did not ask his supporters to "stand down" until later, once the violence had died down.

**So, where are we now?**

**The Committee has been clear there is still a lot left to unravel and that more hearings are sure to come in September.** We know right-wing media and personalities will do everything in their power to discredit the hearings and try to convince Americans that January 6 was a “peaceful protest.”

**It's up to us to protect the truth and make sure Donald Trump and the Treason Caucus are held accountable for their crimes against our country.** The Committee has done an excellent job exposing their lies, but we need to unseat them in November to make sure they can never attack our democracy again.

body:
Friend,

On Tuesday, Michigan held a successful primary election. Close to two million Michigan voters exercised their constitutional right to vote absentee and Michiganders that chose to vote in person were able to do so quickly and conveniently.

I’m proud to say the Michigan primary was a great day for democracy. And of course, we know that in light of the coordinated effort to undermine our elections, this has not been an easy feat. It required the dedicated work of local clerks, poll workers, and volunteers all across the state, who braved potential threats of harassment to work on the frontlines of our democracy. I, for one, am so grateful for all of the citizens who stepped up to make our primary election both possible and fair.

I believe a trusted election administration is critical to a well-functioning democracy, and as secretary of state, I have shared my vision for how we can conduct safe, secure, and transparent elections for all Michiganders.

My opponent in November’s election does not share this belief. If she becomes secretary of state, primaries just like the one we held on Tuesday will become another opportunity for election deniers to sow disarray and confusion, and interfere with our basic democratic processes.

Now, earlier this week Dan reached out to you about an important official campaign fundraising goal we need to hit by this Friday. Reaching this goal is critical to ensuring we have the resources to get my message out all across the state before Election Day.

We’re nearly halfway to completing this goal, friend. Will you pitch in to help ensure that I can continue to provide Michiganders withs afe, secure and transparent elections in our state? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=080422]

It’s official: We have our Republican opponent in Arizona. Here’s what that means for our race:

Our opponent is backed by an out-of-state billionaire in Silicon Valley, and his Super PAC can spend virtually unlimited sums of money on this race — whatever it takes to defeat us. We just don’t get it.
❌Map manipulators in states like Alabama and Louisiana have passed congressional maps that expressly limit the voting power of people of color.
❌Far-right justices on the Supreme Court have allowed these maps to stand.
❌Far-right senators all voted against a measure in the Freedom to Vote Act legislation that would ban partisan gerrymandering in federal elections.
❌All across the country, far right extremists are pushing unfair, gerrymandered, and alienating maps.
Why are they not interested in maintaining American democracy?
Why are they so concerned with restricting the right to vote?
Why do they continue to make partisan gerrymandered maps?
**The answer is because many on the far right -- plain and simple -- are hell-bent on retaining power.**
Fair map advocates are the exact opposite. What we want is simple: a fair map-making process, maps that enfranchise people of color, and an end to manipulated maps that silence the voices of voters. Is that too much to ask for?

| _**Regan Deering for Congress **_
---
| | | Dear Peter,

I don’t believe you can spend inflation away. But the far-Left seems to think they can . . .

The brand new "Inflation Reduction Act" is actually a $433 billion Schumer-Manchin tax-and-spend package!

This reckless package will be paid for by increasing taxes on hard-working Americans who are already struggling with skyrocketing energy prices and the highest inflation in four decades.

Yet, Joe Biden [pledged ](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=4f1a71c126&e=2fa613cb76)not to raise taxes for Americans making less than $400,000 a year and yet, by 2023 this legislation is [expected to](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=382dce2b67&e=2fa613cb76) increase taxes by $16.7 billion on American taxpayers earning less than $200,000 and by $14.1 billion from taxpayers earning between $200,000 and $500,000.

We need to deal with inflation head-on by reducing regulations on our businesses and encouraging them to invest, innovate, produce and manufacture here in the United States. We need some more adults in the room who are willing to provide immediate relief, along with long-term solutions based on economic principles, rather than quick-fix spending sprees.

Not more rubber stamps for the Biden-Pelosi-Schumer agenda, an agenda my opponent, Nikki Budzinski, is quite familiar with as a Biden Administration alum.

If you want CHANGE in Washington, vote for me.

| |
#

Dear Derek,

This week the two major parties nominated their candidates for Missouri’s open seat in the United States Senate and neither is good enough for Missouri. They are out of touch with the values and principles of people all across our state, and I believe you deserve better.

The race for the general election began this week, and here’s what I believe:
* Missourians are looking for a common-sense candidate who’s ready to get to work addressing the real issues facing our state and nation.
* Missouri needs a Senator who will help our families, communities, and country move beyond division. We don’t need more uncomfortable gatherings where people feel angry and pushed to take sides.
* We have more in common than the loud voices on the political extremes try to tell us!
* Voters across the political spectrum share the same concerns: addressing inflation, delivering excellent education & health, and ensuring the safety and security of our communities and our country.
* Missouri deserves a Senator who’s willing to find the common ground and provide real solutions.
* Missouri voters are ready to say enough is enough and work together to build bridges.
* We will win this election and with your help, we’ll rewrite the narrative on politics in our state.

Thanks to support from people like you, I’m taking this message all over Missouri starting this month and I could use your help!

**Here are a few actions you can take today to help our campaign:**
---
| Consider donating any amount ($5, $10, $20...). We know times are tough, and every bit makes a difference!
---
| | [DONATE](https://gmail.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8837c883094c7edaa240fcc4&id=133c31607f&e=6306d47db1 "DONATE")
---
| Sign up to HELP or HOST a Meet & Greet!
---
| [VOLUNTEER](https://gmail.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8837c883094c7edaa240fcc4&id=d2b3bb4fcd&e=6306d47db1 "VOLUNTEER")
---
| Forward this email – invite your family, friends, neighbors and co-workers to join us!
---
| **My team and I are grateful for your support and are ready to win this race in November Let's do this!**

Sincerely,

John

| | | Derek, **__**_This is what you expect to see when you’re ahead in the polls, and when it’s clear you’re the only candidate who can win in November..._ To no surprise, my primary opponents have started to send attacks and barbs my way since they know our 603 Mission is the frontrunner. name: Team Slotkin
subject: ICYMI: What we learned from our primary
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220804&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220804&amount=28]
Team,
It’s all been leading up to this: we’ve made it through the primary. Elissa officially has an opponent to run against, and she’s not wasting any time.
Yesterday, she sent out a recap of the primary results AND she’s already challenged her opponent to two debates, a challenge that he accepted. You can read Elissa’s full primary breakdown below.
Ultimately Elissa firmly believes that voters in Michigan’s new 7th district deserve to know who is running to represent them, what they believe, and what they plan to do if elected. In the most competitive House race in Michigan and one of the ten most competitive in the entire country, we intend to spread that message to every voter we possibly can.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220804&amount=28]
Team Slotkin
Friend,
The results from yesterday’s primary are in. I will officially be running against Tom Barrett to represent Michigan’s new 7th district in Congress.
Even though my race was uncontested, we’re true data nerds here on Team Slotkin – and as such, we had our campaign war room up and running at our headquarters, working late into the night, parsing through election results. I wanted to share a few of our initial takeaways:
Going into the night, we expected that there would be more votes overall in the Republican primary in our race than in the Democratic primary – that was the natural assumption, since the Republicans had a hotly contested primary for Governor at the top of the ticket, and the Democratic ticket, from Governor on down, was all unopposed.
And yet, our campaign received more overall votes than our opponent did last night – 77,207 to his 74,902.
Not surprisingly, we outran him in Ingham County, home to most of the city of Lansing. That’s an area that I currently represent in Michigan's 8th district.
But there was one county that really took us by surprise: in Eaton County, Tom Barrett’s home county that he currently represents in the Michigan Senate, I again got more votes than he did – and this is a county new to me in the re-drawn 7th district.
And it wasn’t just the more urban parts of Eaton County (the ones that fall within the city of Lansing) where I got more votes: I also outran my opponent in the city of Grand Ledge, and the more rural village of Dimondale.
We’re still going through the full results, but I wanted to at least share these initial results because they speak to what we’ve been hearing on the doors: voters are itching to get out to vote, to make their voices heard in some way, and our high turnout numbers point to that trajectory over the next 97 days.
We saw this last night in Kansas, where an overwhelming majority voted not to criminalize abortion in their state constitution. We’ll have a very similar opportunity on our ballots in Michigan this November, where we’ll be voting on a ballot proposal to enshrine the standard of Roe in our state constitution – given that we currently have a 1931 law on the books outlawing abortion.
For now, I’ll leave you with this: service is the greatest love letter you can write to your country. I’m grateful for the opportunity to represent the folks of mid-Michigan, and I thank you for being along for this ride with me.

---
| | **VOTE TUESDAY**
---
| | Friends,

As we get ready for the last few days of the campaign, I've finished up another phenomenal week of talking to voters, all across Connecticut, and hearing their concerns. I'm excited to win this coming Tuesday and take on Senator Blumenthal in November. Please make sure to get out and vote, and please bring your likeminded friends and family with you! We have an opportunity to send a consistent conservative to Washington D.C. and I hope I can count on your vote.

I spent most of my time this past week talking to as many voters as I can, to hear their concerns and share my vision for Connecticut. I spent last Thursday doing that in Bridgeport, and on Saturday I joined my friend George Logan, who is running in the 5th Congressional District, to knock doors with him and his team in New Britain. After that we stopped by the Lebanon Fair and the Bethel Lobster Festival.
---
|
---
| On Sunday we went doorknocking in Norwich and I was joined by two good friends of mine. The first was Norwich City Treasurer, Michael Gualtieri. The other was Robert Bell, who is running for State Rep in the Norwich area. Robert and I even had a chance to visit a few local small businesses after we finished door knocking for the day. Finally, Tuesday was National Night Out, and I was thrilled to join the Stamford Police to spend time with the community. As your Senator, I promise i will never support the Democrats radical Defund the Police agenda and that I will always back the brave men and women in blue.
---
|

|

---

Peter Lumaj

It’s what powers our campaign to fight for hardworking Americans across the country. Look, I know it gets old with our campaign texting, emailing, and calling you nonstop, but I’d be lying if I didn’t say that your support is the **LIFEBLOOD OF OUR CAMPAIGN.** | [**RUSH A DONATION TO OUR CAMPAIGN HERE**](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=82cf28bce58d40a69eca2b0dfabd4581&_e=Uu6BGTJZKbbzxoV6pa81mQn-4UdqsQsR_EJqA667ZVmAAkseRuYfOgK7eVK9yRgSBESpAqx4OY6aRsRnKuBDu_6-OiY9wuVaz36hBuwSMZmmJnZEWRBW7pLniy1BxXApRvRV2cNJIft6OWxnaCg5Ayg24jZxpFIslGKZe9hFWbHNjX6S9-CXg4ya3TM5g_enLmivab9VYspOhSf_356_L1FI-j9JTweNYdx2TZ8zE6ghDX0ndcH920o8VzWfKMDMMp9Yg09Niy-Pbk_FX8GgEAhKtyKzja-T0ubr-ZFw6K8wdA7FfWnoZ5DaG-Yb2nFVwTH0UniY_HwbFpYXeJuX1Cnt7PAdmIAMu7zbE79M9tOkaLLFOOAcwDQVKU_dH80nS5eWJxcfKFOSDmwDN-2suXOTbLkYcnGllVy46ArDUFJ3Fdf33FrJtp7jV8_OSEYhbtMXAFhUd-EqpAW_Yd7aw2oR5lYa7jbAw85zJsWRX69sQ7wN5XQsGrkVPb4rz5FLzo2esa-QPtLhoLajuf9CPw%3D%3D)

I hope you know that the main reason I’m running for the U.S. Senate seat in Ohio is because I care deeply about my state, my country, and the issues that we’re facing right now.
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=82cf28bce58d40a69eca2b0dfabd4581&_e=Uu6BGTJZKbbzxoV6pa81mQn-4UdqsQsR_EJqA667ZVmAAkseRuYfOgK7eVK9yRgSBESpAqx4OY6aRsRnKuBDu_6-OiY9wuVaz36hBuwSMZmmJnZEWRBW7pLniy1BxXApRvRV2cNJIft6OWxnaCg5Ayg24jZxpFIslGKZe9hFWbHNjX6S9-CXg4ya3TM5g_enLmivab9VYspOhSf_356_L1FI-j9JTweNYdx2TZ8zE6ghDX0ndcH920o8VzWfKMDMMp9Yg09Niy-Pbk_FX8GgEAhKtyKzja-T0ubr-ZFw6K8wdA7FfWnoZ5DaG-Yb2nFVSyKNGRJizUXQTJ8JEYQkRdvXZFGOtVj2I0o4X1__d1YDsMOoKHe3VbaS5QoBhVhBLws5-E-Y6VksFS16nV658wsyVNerbHAePiS4hQj19UCh1CMOFky87I1Z8J6TNW1P_7KTtMLd5gbTa0h5Hvj1sre-YlY0939jnrQ7LQOVPMYvChMUSet7CUkLeWyBzs9Fq01Veh7unarb8ayiL9kwXQ%3D%3D)
I grew up in Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once a booming manufacturing town where Ohioans could live a middle-class life. As I got older, I realized that the jobs and economic opportunities that were once present in my hometown were fading away and it left the community around me grasping for hope.

Look, I won’t sugarcoat it, my home life wasn’t all peaches and cream. I had my fair share of turbulence at home as a kid, with my dad leaving home when I was young, and my mother struggling with drug addiction her entire life. I’m so lucky that I had someone who helped me turn everything around and keep me straight. That person was my Mamaw (my grandmother).

My grandmother taught me tough love, discipline, and that the world wasn’t just going to hand you what you wanted. She kept me straight and focused through her dedication to faith, family, and the hope of a better life that lay ahead (or it could’ve been the 19 handguns she owned.)
[](http://links.jdforohio.org/u/click?_t=52e88da6462b43fd9dbbfea97c7983e9&_m=82cf28bce58d40a69eca2b0dfabd4581&_e=Uu6BGTJZKbbzxoV6pa81mQn-4UdqsQsR_EJqA667ZVmAAkseRuYfOgK7eVK9yRgSBESpAqx4OY6aRsRnKuBDu_6-OiY9wuVaz36hBuwSMZmmJnZEWRBW7pLniy1BxXApRvRV2cNJIft6OWxnaCg5Ayg24jZxpFIslGKZe9hFWbHNjX6S9-CXg4ya3TM5g_enLmivab9VYspOhSf_356_L1FI-j9JTweNYdx2TZ8zE6ghDX0ndcH920o8VzWfKMDMMp9Yg09Niy-Pbk_FX8GgEAhKtyKzja-T0ubr-ZFw6K8wdA7FfWnoZ5DaG-Yb2nFVZ6T1Otne6zFXYfxgjRrOLSu5ZpfxC2BZ7Eh8Ux5n6Ctovuf4kS4eIow2qclE-zN9lnop0QGYdaBblkkspHe3zKINXMJqrSrb1OOM32MmKNYKEMsd3lMMTd_E-BdT5pZF9ItJkXS5LH26rpbBoCLsnQfXjmQsCsZ-9DxktWveLUOIM8N55WMKWLdUs7LKp39Nq-i1-UzeKdui0tjtOywwDA%3D%3D)
You wouldn’t believe it from the photo above, but I went on to serve my nation in the Iraq War as a proud Marine, graduated from The Ohio State University, received my law degree from Yale Law School, and wrote a bestselling book.

That wasn’t enough. I wanted to do more. I wanted to do more for my state and my country.

That’s why when I moved back to Ohio and saw the state I love devastated by job loss, addiction, economic turmoil, and much more, I started a business in Cincinnati focused on growing companies that create well-paying jobs.

I’m not done yet though, I’m running for the U.S. Senate because Ohio and America need a true conservative who’s focused on standing up to Communist China, securing our Southern Border, and looking out for the people who’ve been left behind. Because I know what that feels like.

So, if you’re committed to putting America First again, if you’re committed to standing up to the Woke Left’s Socialist Agenda, and you’re focused on protecting your freedoms and conservative values, [**_please rush a donation below to support our campaign. clean_body: | Friend, Before we get started and I go any further, I’d just like to take a moment to thank you for your time and previous support in advance. It’s what powers our campaign to fight for hardworking Americans across the country. Look, I know it gets old with our campaign texting, emailing, and calling you nonstop, but I’d be lying if I didn’t say that your support is the LIFEBLOOD OF OUR CAMPAIGN. | I hope you know that the main reason I’m running for the U.S. Senate seat in Ohio is because I care deeply about my state, my country, and the issues that we’re facing right now. I grew up in Middletown, Ohio. Middletown was once a booming manufacturing town where Ohioans could live a middle-class life. As I got older, I realized that the jobs and economic opportunities that were once present in my hometown were fading away and it left the community around me grasping for hope. Look, I won’t sugarcoat it, my home life wasn’t all peaches and cream. I had my fair share of turbulence at home as a kid, with my dad leaving home when I was young, and my mother struggling with drug addiction her entire life. I’m so lucky that I had someone who helped me turn everything around and keep me straight. That person was my Mamaw (my grandmother). My grandmother taught me tough love, discipline, and that the world wasn’t just going to hand you what you wanted. She kept me straight and focused through her dedication to faith, family, and the hope of a better life that lay ahead (or it could’ve been the 19 handguns she owned.) You wouldn’t believe it from the photo above, but I went on to serve my nation in the Iraq War as a proud Marine, graduated from The Ohio State University, received my law degree from Yale Law School, and wrote a bestselling book. That wasn’t enough. I wanted to do more. I wanted to do more for my state and my country. That’s why when I moved back to Ohio and saw the state I love devastated by job loss, addiction, economic turmoil, and much more, I started a business in Cincinnati focused on growing companies that create well-paying jobs. I’m not done yet though, I’m running for the U.S. Senate because Ohio and America need a true conservative who’s focused on standing up to Communist China, securing our Southern Border, and looking out for the people who’ve been left behind. Because I know what that feels like. So, if you’re committed to putting America First again, if you’re committed to standing up to the Woke Left’s Socialist Agenda, and you’re focused on protecting your freedoms and conservative values, Let’s ride. It’s time to get back to work. God Bless you and your family, JD Vance Conservative Outsider. Marine. Businessman. Author. Ohio needs a true conservative in the U.S. Senate. It needs someone who understands how our economic and government leaders conspire to make life harder for normal Americans. Ohio needs JD Vance. name: Alex Padilla
subject: The biggest climate bill in history
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
Together, we’re going to pass a major step forward in the fight for climate justice and the future of our planet.
#

Hi team, it's Alex.
I'll be direct — I'm writing to tell you about the climate bill and to ask you to [**add your name to mine to call on Congress to pass it immediately.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/climate-emergency-em-Aug22/?source=em220722-1-90&refcode2=924.159979.jGfyGe&akid=924%2E159979%2EjGfyGe)
Here's why I'm asking:
This bill — the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 — is the biggest climate bill in history. It’ll cut pollution in half by 2030 while creating millions of good-paying jobs in clean energy and reducing energy costs for working families in California and across the country.
And we’ll pay for it by finally making the largest and most powerful corporations in the country pay their fair share in taxes.
Climate change is one of the greatest threats facing our nation and our planet. And the truth is, every day we wait to act is another day we continue to live with the devastating consequences of climate change. More frequent and severe storms, deadly heat waves, rampaging wildfires here in California... this is all happening right now, not in some far-off future.
**We have got to act now, and that means passing this climate bill now. So please:**
[**Join me in calling on my colleagues in the Senate to take up and pass the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 right away.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/climate-emergency-em-Aug22/?source=em220722-1-90&refcode2=924.159979.jGfyGe&akid=924%2E159979%2EjGfyGe)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.alex-padilla.com/signup/climate-emergency-em-Aug22/?source=em220722-1-90&refcode2=924.159979.jGfyGe&akid=924%2E159979%2EjGfyGe)**
I know adding your name might seem like a small action, but when thousands of us stand together and demand change, we can accomplish great things.
Thank you for not giving up. Together, we’re going to pass a major step forward in the fight for climate justice and the future of our planet.
\- Alex

After a decade or more of memories from raising a family, it’s a tragedy to be forced to pack it all up and move. Even worse for those who still take care of elderly parents and kids in school. Young people don’t see a future here and aren’t given the chance to build their own memories and financial stability that past generations have relied on. As a City of Miami Commissioner, I’ve brought in hundreds of millions in new affordable housing and passed a $15 minimum wage. But we can do so much more to not only lower the cost of housing but to fight inflation and help make sure no one, especially children, goes hungry. In Congress, I’ll pass a nationwide $15 minimum wage and mandate even more investments in affordable housing. [**Can you chip in $25 right now to make even more change at the national level?**](http://links.kenrussellforfloridaemail.com/u/click?_t=cee06b13e3c1411baa566b417c320e45&_m=e4b812e863b742efa4229dc9c98765c2&_e=lWMI59ZR84epzvFrFvxXiQdRxi88dd_X8GPindWegMETtEQ9mFTitWRugjvjh2c0srtFodd78wqam2FsHHcgm5OwtVfD9QEPPGXKnn0HbPG2vfuE31xw0DUNrCv6Cm2eztHuOs14mtLEg-TUbasX8lq39hiED5Sfcj61GkqnksQd6k6wgpjSkPsLPUCsNO9DJjeTJrwyASOt7a4GBiHVETsro3Bl3nPuxnrSdpDAglJkAJd_d598_TyhiNfvxN8NfhNK8quWR4h1KulaTZsHgBlLbESz6Ss1ArjT_uDtlE3Bgv_XBj4zUklMwOyi-TfeEE-AUu1fhDVNzGl0b8mXIjseS-NloKk4LXbUvMRfnXNIWTADPnrI81VS8IyJek0tdltAE_8CY6aYIPZbY-5nbhUfHNlxhiRxrGDKCvZYd7lnZ4e48kBHzIixxkvChxrvbKp7-0CnCvFNuaytEwSc3XSIyj40Q3zhm67I9NoiECvTsI8eCJAJvssZW4ADtJX6VuMtNK77EZNaaR_8y1QHxq0hnXeqNWkpPER2eGOVlMqNosURVgrJawqByGPClaqx) [](http://links.kenrussellforfloridaemail.com/u/click?_t=cee06b13e3c1411baa566b417c320e45&_m=e4b812e863b742efa4229dc9c98765c2&_e=lWMI59ZR84epzvFrFvxXiTCIOtC1taYB5zuPU6vyndgTs2TFetzi6ae18LyAyJEi6HQQDueTUExsnNQEAEHlU8JjYN06C2VsSD5OIumh_tNYecsRmNc9EEQ77i1fRLM99Q1FAsoj3QRQYlbViU1jpWZHEJ-9ueh2TX4ENsYRpDkt7WoyiY05jqhOGlUob7VmHT1RbV6TNljYz--4z2L59u-Pxpc5Il9e6hHZ8nP4w99aokCj8F842JlqvrfNmephgsfStXV5G3qrqfOaVcJurem85WSGJvRSdZTPs_UhpvKxyXGFS6OvFqN8Jkxt7rE7eYwMxQsDyOidQT24BqxeJ4Zu54sqjV5smqnXvXva9zgojtyCkkjxIB0qE_HA2f9BQIzDus7YCjq--eGF9i7vww%3D%3D) Miami is an amazing place, but with housing prices skyrocketing at the rate that they are, we risk losing out on what makes our community so special. clean_body: Team, Miami’s affordable housing crisis is one of the worst in the country. After a decade or more of memories from raising a family, it’s a tragedy | | | Team, Miami’s affordable housing crisis is one of the worst in the country. After a decade or more of memories from raising a family, it’s a tragedy to be forced to pack it all up and move. Even worse for those who still take care of elderly parents and kids in school. Young people don’t see a future here and aren’t given the chance to build their own memories and financial stability that past generations have relied on. As a City of Miami Commissioner, I’ve brought in hundreds of millions in new affordable housing and passed a $15 minimum wage. But we can do so much more to not only lower the cost of housing but to fight inflation and help make sure no one, especially children, goes hungry. In Congress, I’ll pass a nationwide $15 minimum wage and mandate even more investments in affordable housing. Miami is an amazing place, but with housing prices skyrocketing at the rate that they are, we risk losing out on what makes our community so special. I believe housing is a right, not a privilege. Every single person deserves a roof over their head and a job that pays them enough to be comfortable and live a wonderful life. I am running for this seat to fight for working families and to implement real solutions to this crisis. I know people are struggling, and I know that we have to take action NOW. Thank you so much. – Ken Russell Ken Russell is a Democrat running for U.S. Congress in Florida's 27th District. Charles Booker
